descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Employee Service At Salesforce

Salesforce Employee Service powers next-generation internal support and service management. Our platform enables organizations to deliver seamless IT and HR experiences to their workforce by:

  • Automating internal service processes and streamlining cross-departmental workflows.
  • Leveraging AI to intelligently mine knowledge, resolve employee inquiries instantly, and power autonomous, agent-driven interactions.
  • Delivering exceptional employee experiences with intelligent case routing, predictive insights, and real-time collaboration tools that boost enterprise productivity.

About The Role

We’re seeking a visionary Director of Product Management to lead our next-generation AI initiatives and drive the strategy of AI-first, collaboration-first, and platform-centric innovations across our Employee Service portfolio (spanning IT Service Management and HR Service Delivery). This role is critical to building enterprise-grade internal service solutions that empower employees, IT helpdesks, and HR teams at scale.

You will lead the charge in transitioning our employee service paradigm from reactive ticketing to proactive, autonomous workflows. You will build and scale enterprise-grade Agentic AI systems, determining how autonomous agents collaborate with human employees, integrating state-of-the-art LLMs, and defining the future of AI-first work.

As the owner of the AI roadmap, you will translate the latest industry trends—spanning Generative AI and Predictive Machine Learning—into scalable product features. Working cross-functionally with engineering, data science, UX, sales, and marketing, you will ensure our AI solutions remain cutting-edge, secure, and highly impactful for transforming how enterprises support their workforce.

What You’ll Do

  • Define Product Strategy: Own the product vision and strategy for AI-driven capabilities within Employee Service (IT and HR domains), ensuring alignment with broader business goals.
  • Agentic AI Leadership: Lead the conceptualization and delivery of Agentic AI workflows, enabling autonomous, task-oriented AI agents to resolve internal IT tickets and HR requests.
  • Architectural Strategy: Drive product and architectural decisions around LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks. You will own the trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and context window optimization.
  • AI Trust, Safety & Evals: Design robust evaluation frameworks for AI agents to measure accuracy, mitigate hallucinations, manage prompt injection risks, and maintain enterprise-grade data privacy.
  • AI-First UX: Define the UX paradigms for human-in-the-loop (HITL) interactions, ensuring seamless handoffs between autonomous agents and employees/IT Teams.
  • Customer Discovery & Integration: Engage directly with enterprise customers to understand complex pain points, specifically focusing on how they discover, adopt, and integrate AI applications into their internal IT, HR, and custom enterprise ecosystems (e.g., via API-based integrations and secure server environments).
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate deeply with engineering, data science, and UX teams to build scalable, intuitive, and high-performance AI solutions, driving prioritization and trade-offs.
  • Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with sales, marketing, and enablement teams to define GTM strategies, positioning, and messaging to ensure successful product launches and market adoption.
  • Executive Communication: Regularly present product updates, AI strategies, and measurable results to C-suite leadership and external partners, ensuring continuous alignment.
  • Data-Driven Iteration: Leverage data-driven insights to continuously improve product offerings, tracking employee adoption, operational cost savings, and market share expansion.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 14+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, with a demonstrated track record of taking an Agentic product from 0-to-1 and scaling it in a production environment.
  • AI/ML Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with LLM orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), embedding models, vector databases, and designing autonomous agent loops (planning, tool use, reflection). You deeply understand the trade-offs between different foundation models and fine-tuning vs. RAG approaches. Strong working knowledge of predictive ML models and data pipelines.
  • Technical Fluency: Experience with AI evaluation techniques (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge) and continuous model improvement cycles based on human feedback. Ability to engage deeply with engineering and data science teams on architectural tradeoffs, model selection, and performance metrics.
  • Strategic Execution: Proven track record of developing and executing comprehensive, multi-quarter product roadmaps that drive measurable business impact.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to navigate stakeholder alignment and articulate complex AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Preferred Domain Knowledge: A proven ability to build scalable AI/LLM products is essential. Familiarity with Salesforce AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Data Cloud) and prior experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), HR Service Delivery, or Employee Workflows are highly preferred but not mandatory.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that transform internal support experiences for enterprises.
  • Collaborate with a world-class team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Shape the future of intelligent employee service management and drive meaningful impact by solving real organizational challenges at scale.
  • Be part of a culture of innovation, collaboration, personal growth and continuous learning.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

descriptionHtml:
Serko is a cutting-edge tech platform in global business travel & expense technology. When you join Serko, you become part of a team of passionate travellers and technologists bringing people together, using the world's leading business travel marketplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, we embrace the richness of diversity, showing up authentically to create a positive impact. There's an exciting road ahead of us, where travel needs real, impactful change.

With offices in New Zealand, Australia, North America, and China, we are thrilled to be expanding our global footprint, landing our growing and established hub in Bengaluru, India. With rapid a growth plan in place for India, we're hiring people from different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to help us build a world-class team and product.

As one of the Directors of Product at Serko, you will oversee the development of platform shared services that creates the foundation for all of our travel product offerings. You will be responsible for setting and executing the product strategy and roadmap for those services in close collaboration with the Director of Engineering, Platform. In addition, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver exceptional products that meet customer needs and drive business success downstream from the platform delivery. It is expected that you will deliver AI-native platform services that will fuel Serko's most modern agentic products - as such, you will be expected to align and collaborate with other Directors of Product who will rely on the platform to make their product experiences come to life. Successful candidates are expected to demonstrate high levels of technical acumen and have a demonstrated track record of building world-class technology platforms (or similar shared technology services).


Requirements

What you'll do

Platform Product Strategy and Roadmap:

  • Closely collaborating with key stakeholders including Directors of Engineering for Platform, and Directors of Product of Serko's travel Products
  • Translates business strategy and product requirements into scalable, reusable capabilities that evolve shared services into a strategic asset. 
  • Independently anticipates future needs to drive operational efficiency and company-wide innovation with critical inputs from Directors of Product of Serko's travel products
  • Sets clear goals, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives
  • Curates and sequences the platform roadmap by balancing validated travel product demands with strategic priorities
  • Manages trade-offs between resourcing and platform investment. 

AI Innovation:

  • Implements modern technologies into platform product designs to ensure Serko's products are at the forefront of technology solutions for customers, including AI-native experiences
  • Leverages data and insights to drive continuous improvement of product delivery for platform

Stakeholder Communication:

  • Collaborates with product, technology and commercial (Revenue) peers to ensure platform delivery is aligned to company delivery, customer expectations and customer success
  • Communicates effectively with stakeholders, including executives, customers, and partners, to ensure alignment, support for product initiatives and report progress of platform delivery
  • Presents platform product strategies, roadmaps and updates to senior leadership, influencing decisions with compelling data insights

End-to-End Product Management:

  • Delivers world-class platform products that fuel e-commerce experiences for the corporate travel industry, from customer-facing tools to supply-side aggregation and partnerships with 3rd party plugins
  • Oversees the entire platform product lifecycle from ideation to launch, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality standards, while quickly and effectively solving any faults
  • Drives an AI-first platform agenda, ensuring infrastructure is designed to natively support model-driven and agentic product experiences (real-time inference, orchestration, and scalable data pipelines) as a default, not an add-on
  • Raises the bar on velocity with precision, embedding experimentation, automated testing (including model validation), and continuous delivery practices that enable rapid, confident shipping of AI-powered features
  • Owns the evolution of infrastructure as a direct product enabler, delivering scalable, observable, and governed systems that accelerate AI product delivery while meeting enterprise standards for reliability, security, and trust
  • Acts as a bridge between strategic and tactical execution, knowing when to zoom out to empower teams and when to zoom in to remove blockers

Collaborative Development:

  • Partners with cross-functional teams to drive customer outcomes from discovery to launch
  • Collaborates with other product teams  to develop compelling value propositions that drive product adoption and revenue growth

Performance Metrics and Optimization:

  • Defines and tracks key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure platform product success, impact on business objectives, and product adoption
  • Uses data-driven insights to optimize performance and inform strategic decisions in the most effective products to achieve Serko's business objectives

Leadership and Mentorship:

  • Fosters a collaborative and innovative team culture that encourages data-driven decision-making, creativity and continuous improvement
  • Acts as a mentor for other Product Managers across the company to support their ongoing professional development
  • Models AI-native principles in platform delivery encouraging the use and application of AI in platform product delivery
  • Mentor more junior product management staff, even in situations where no direct reporting lines exist, to ensure a continuous learning opportunity for our people

What you'll bring to the team

  • Demonstrable experience in strategic product leadership, demonstrating success in both strategic planning and hands-on execution in a high-growth technology company building technology infrastructure and platforms
  • Ability to translate complex engineering constraints and architectural trade-offs into clear product decisions and to translate travel product requirements back into technically precise platform inputs
  • Deep understanding of product management principles, methodologies, and best practices, especially for high-velocity product development of technology platforms and infrastructure
  • Experience in designing, building and optimizing API-first platforms and shared infrastructure to support e-commerce products with consumer-grade experiences on modern technologies (including AI agentic products)
  • Hunger to learn new technologies and implement ever evolving technological advances into product design and development
  • Strong evidence of analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in data-driven decision making, experimentation in product development, utilisation of data and research to inform product strategies and optimize performance
  • Proven expertise in data-driven decision making that drives continuous improvement in product development
  • Strong commercial acumen  and data-driven approach to decision-making and building products that drive business growth
  • Ability to balance long-term strategy with shorter-term tactical execution, ensuring both high-level vision and operational effectiveness
  • Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams as well as work collaboratively across disciplines in the business
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, capable of conveying complex ideas, analytical results and complex business problems to diverse audiences
  • Strong adaptability and resilience, adept at navigating ambiguity, working in uncertainty and driving results in a fast-paced tech environment
  • Experience in the travel tech industry is preferred, or a demonstrated understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities in the business travel industry
  • Appetite to deeply understand the regulatory environment, the complex competitive landscape, and business trends of the evolving corporate travel industry

Benefits

At Serko we aim to create a place where people can come and do their best work.  This means you'll be operating in an environment with great tools and support to enable you to perform at the highest level of your abilities, producing high-quality, and delivering innovative and efficient results. Our people are fully engaged, continuously improving, and encouraged to make an impact.

  • Some of the benefits of working at Serko are:
  • A competitive base pay
  • Medical Benefits
  • Discretionary incentive plan based on individual and company performance
  • Focus on development: Access to a learning & development platform and opportunity for you to own your career pathways
  • Flexible work policy

Apply

Hit the ‘apply' button now, or explore more about what it's like to work at Serko and all our global opportunities at www.Serko.com .

You will be responsible for building innovative monetization models, crafting delightful and habit-forming experiences, improving personalized recommendations, and unlocking exponential growth in user engagement and revenue. You will work cross-functionally with design, engineering, data science, marketing, operations, and content teams to shape the product roadmap and drive executive decisions.


Key responsibilities

Product strategy & roadmapping

  • Define and own the product vision and roadmap across monetisation, experience, recommendations, and growth
  • Align the roadmap with business goals, user insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence
  • Build long-term strategies that balance revenue growth with sustainable user value and retention


Monetisation innovation

  • Lead monetisation initiatives across subscriptions, microtransactions, loyalty programs, offers, and bundling strategies
  • Optimize pricing, paywalls, and feature gating to maximize LTV while maintaining a high NPS
  • Leverage A/B testing and behavioral insights to validate monetisation hypotheses and iterate quickly


User experience & retention

  • Craft seamless and intuitive experiences across the entire user journey, from onboarding and discovery to engagement and conversion
  • Identify friction points and use design thinking and data insights to enhance usability and satisfaction
  • Run continuous experiments to boost core engagement metrics and reduce churn


Recommendations & personalization

  • Partner with data science and engineering to drive advancements in our recommendation engine
  • Define user cohorts and behavioral signals to power contextual and personalized content discovery
  • Measure and optimize content consumption patterns to increase session depth and frequency


Growth & acquisition

  • Design and execute features and experiments that improve user acquisition, onboarding, referral, and conversion funnels
  • Collaborate with performance marketing and growth teams to amplify paid and organic levers
  • Leverage growth loops, gamification, and community features to create viral mechanics and increase user stickiness


What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of experience in consumer product management, ideally in B2C, social, content, or entertainment platforms
  • A proven track record of owning and scaling monetisation, growth, or recommendation-driven products
  • Strong analytical and experimentation skills, comfortable with SQL, dashboards, and deriving actionable insights
  • High user empathy with a passion for storytelling, creator platforms, or media consumption behavior
  • Deep experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and agile environment
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and stakeholder management abilities

descriptionHtml:
Global Product Manager for Custody Digital Onboarding

The Custody Product Manager is a strategic position responsible for driving the core Custody product function. With a critical focus on digital transformation and data-driven insights, the role integrates traditional and innovative solutions across the Custody product lifecycle, aiming for competitive advantage and commercial outcomes. This role champions key product priorities, including digital onboarding strategy, AI-powered solutions, financial performance, innovation, controls & governance, and talent development. Collaboration with Coverage teams, Products across Investor Services teams, Operations, and Technology is essential to jointly achieve shared business goals.

Focusing on digitization of the client onboarding experience through various intake channels, industry utilities and integration with internal applications. Significant improvement to end to end client experience, delivering simplicity and increase client satisfaction through reduction of account opening cycle times, market documentation and requirements and improvement operational efficiency. The individual will work closely with business, legal, risk and operational partners identifying and implementing product change and enhancements in line with business, efficiency, regulatory and market mandatory requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage strategic program roadmap, development, and launch as it relates to digital onboarding solutions
  • Supervise day-to-day product management for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results
  • Drive client value propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to Citi clients
  • Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, multiple countries, region, or business requiring coordination and integration across units as well as provide input into strategic decisions affecting job family or function within a region or business
  • Manage client and competitor market research, develop product innovation roadmap, and address fundamental trials of product commoditization to create an advanced set of solutions
  • Direct and oversee all aspects of program life cycle management including market demands, technology trends, and the competitive field
  • Drive achievement of acquisition targets, product financial performance, revenue performance, and expense management goals as well as oversee identification and execution of opportunities and gaps business plans
  • Develop and communicate a business plan to approach the marketplace, and coordinate and implement team procedures, client problem resolutions and client management
  • Lead innovation by working with external partners/alliances to develop products, manage ongoing relationships, and prepare agreements
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Product Vision & P&L Ownership: Define and lead the strategic vision for custody products, aggressively integrating digital, data, and innovation to drive P&L growth, market penetration, and sustainable competitive advantage.
  • Digital & Data-Driven Innovation: Champion product differentiation and service enhancement by actively leveraging advanced data analytics, digital capabilities, and emerging technologies throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Global Execution Excellence: Execute global strategic priorities and functional strategies for custody within the assigned market/ cluster, ensuring seamless integration of global platforms, digital initiatives and operational enhancements and Cluster priorities into Global product roadmaps.
  • Client Experience & Value Delivery: Oversee the delivery of superior client experience and communication strategies, executing compelling client value propositions to secure and solidify Citi's leadership position Custody.
  • Market Change Management & Influence: Lead market change initiatives through proactive advocacy, direct regulatory engagement, and by effectively representing the firm's and client's voice to Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs) and Regulators
  • Risk Management: Proactively assess and manage product-related risks, safeguarding Citi's reputation and assets.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Extensive Product Leadership: 15 years of progressive product management experience in custody in complex, global, and matrixed organizations, fostering an techno- commercial approach to strategic decision-making and product development.
  • Digital & Data Expertise with an AI-First Mindset in Financial Services: Deep knowledge and practical experience integrating digital, data analytics, and emerging technologies (including AI/ML concepts and platforms), with a proactive AI-first mindset to identify and apply solutions within custody operations and client experience.
  • Industry & Market Acumen: Sound understanding of the custody industry and investment products. Acute insights into competitor offerings, strategic market direction across fintech, data management, and digital innovation.
  • Strategic & Commercial Acuity: Demonstrated ability to drive commercial outcomes through forward-looking product innovation roadmaps, executing client value propositions across positioning, segmentation, pricing, and digital delivery channels.
  • Innovative & AI-Centric Collaborative Mindset: A highly proactive and innovative mindset, fostering an AI-first, collaborative culture. Outstanding people leadership skills are essential to motivate, influence, and guide teams towards AI-driven technological advancements and business realities.
  • Risk & Compliance Ownership: Adept at assessing and managing product-related risks, ensuring compliance, and safeguarding the firm's reputation, clients, and assets.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree/University degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Director – Group Product Manager, Data & AI Studio Capability

Role Overview

The Director – Group Product Manager, Data & AI Studio Capability will lead the end-to-end product portfolio for the Data & AI Studio, a foundational capability that enables development, deployment, and operation of enterprise data and AI products.

The Data & AI Studio serves as a core enablement layer powering multiple products and use cases, providing standardized capabilities across data ingestion, processing, transformation, and AI/ML development and orchestration.

This role is accountable for product strategy, execution, adoption, and value realization of the Studio capability, ensuring it operates as a scalable, reusable, and platform-aligned product ecosystem. The role also carries full P&L accountability, including investment decisions, prioritization, and value delivery across the portfolio.

The Director will lead a team of product managers and architects, working closely with engineering, enterprise platform teams, and enterprise architecture to deliver consistent, high-impact outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership – Data & AI Studio Capability

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for the Data & AI Studio capability
  • Define how the Studio evolves as a multi-tenant, reusable enablement platform supporting diverse products and use cases
  • Ensure alignment between product vision, platform capabilities, and business priorities
  • P&L Ownership & Value Realization
  • Own P&L accountability for the Studio capability, including
    • Investment prioritization
    • Capacity planning
    • Value realization across product adoption and usage
  • Drive decisions that balance cost, scalability, and business impact
  • Ensure measurable outcomes across
    • Product adoption
    • Capability utilization
    • Business value delivered
Capability Definition & Evolution

  • Define and evolve core Studio capabilities, including
    • Data ingestion frameworks
    • Pipeline orchestration and workflow management
    • Data processing and transformation layers
    • AI/ML development and operationalization
  • Ensure capabilities are
    • Modular and extensible
    • Reusable across multiple products
    • Aligned with enterprise platform and architecture standards
Execution & Delivery Leadership

  • Drive end-to-end execution across Studio capabilities and product teams
  • Establish strong execution discipline, including
    • Sprint and release management
    • Roadmap tracking and milestone governance
  • Ensure alignment between product commitments, engineering delivery, and platform dependencies
Engineering & Platform Alignment

  • Partner closely with engineering leadership to deliver robust and scalable capabilities
  • Ensure alignment with
    • Enterprise platform teams
    • Underlying cloud and data platform ecosystems
  • Drive adoption of shared services, standardized patterns, and reusable platform capabilities
Consumption & Adoption Model

  • Define how the Studio capability is
    • Consumed by multiple product teams
    • Adopted across the organization
  • Establish clear patterns for
    • Onboarding
    • Capability reuse
    • Avoidance of redundant development efforts
  • Drive scale through consistent and repeatable consumption models
Team Leadership – Product Managers & Architects

  • Lead and develop a team of product managers and architects responsible for Studio sub-capabilities
  • Define clear ownership across
    • Capability domains
    • Delivery outcomes
  • Build a high-performing organization focused on
    • Accountability
    • Execution discipline
    • Scalable product thinking
Stakeholder & Portfolio Alignment

  • Engage with product leaders and stakeholders to
    • Align on capability needs and priorities
    • Ensure Studio roadmap reflects enterprise demand
  • Act as the single point of accountability for Studio product direction
Expected Outcomes

  • A scalable, well-defined Data & AI Studio capability powering multiple products
  • Strong adoption of Studio capabilities across product teams
  • Reduced duplication and improved efficiency in data and AI development
  • Consistent and standardized approaches to
    • Data ingestion
    • Pipeline orchestration
    • AI/ML workflows
  • Measurable business impact through effective P&L management and value realization
Experience & Profile

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product management, including leadership across complex, platform-based products
  • Proven experience owning end-to-end product portfolios with P&L accountability
  • Strong understanding of
    • Data pipelines and processing
    • AI/ML development lifecycle
    • Platform-based product architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams (product + architecture)
Technology exposure

  • Databricks
  • Matillion, DBT or similar
  • Collibra or similar
  • Dataiku, Sage maker or similar
  • Agentic AI awareness

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or managing enterprise data or AI platforms
  • Experience driving platform adoption across multiple product teams
  • Experience within global delivery models (US and India)

Leadership Characteristics

  • Strong operator with focus on execution, scale, and measurable outcomes
  • Product leader who understands platforms as enabling ecosystems
  • Ability to manage complexity across multiple products, capabilities, and stakeholders
  • High accountability mindset with ownership of outcomes, value, and delivery

Required Skills

Business Intelligence (BI), Business Management, Database Administration, Data Engineering, Data Management, Data Modeling, Data Pipelines, Data Visualization, Delivering Value, Design Applications, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Enterprise Data, Enterprise Data Management, Enterprise Operations, Financial Decision Making, Information Management, Leadership, Prioritization, Product Management, Product Strategies, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), System Designs

descriptionHtml:
We're partnering with a premium consumer and hospitality company that has built a family of much-loved brands across dining, retail, and experiences. Over the last decade they have earned something rare: people came for the food, and stayed for the feeling.


As the business enters its next phase, they are looking for a senior leader to build the layer that deepens that relationship. Someone who can bring together customer data, CRM, loyalty, community, and AI, not as a set of systems, but as a way to make guests feel known, looked after, and genuinely closer to the brand.

This role reports directly to the founders. The operational foundation, the systems that run the business day to day, is already in place, held by a strong internal team. Your job is to build the growth and experience layer on top of it: the part that turns affection into a lasting, connected relationship across every brand.


What You'll Do

  • Define and drive the company's guest data, CRM, loyalty, and engagement strategy, with a view of loyalty that is about trust and belonging, not just points
  • Build a single, connected view of the guest across brands, channels, and touchpoints, without ever making the experience feel cold or transactional
  • Partner with marketing, CX, content, and business teams to deepen customer journeys, retention, and community
  • Use AI, automation, and technology thoughtfully, where it genuinely improves marketing, retention, service, and decision-making, never for its own sake
  •  Evaluate and bring in the right tools, platforms, and partnerships to support long-term growth, building on the foundation already in place
  • Sit with the founders on the bigger questions: what loyalty and community really mean for a hospitality brand, and how technology can amplify hospitality rather than replace it


What We're Looking For

  • 6 to 12 years across Product, CRM, Customer Experience, Loyalty, Growth, Martech, or Customer Data
  • A track record of building engagement, retention, loyalty, or personalisation initiatives at real scale
  • Strong grasp of CRM ecosystems, customer data, and lifecycle marketing, and the ability to turn data into relationships, not just campaigns
  • Comfortable combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and working through an existing team rather than around it
  • Experience in consumer-facing businesses: retail, hospitality, food, D2C, lifestyle, or technology platforms
  • Hands-on experience with AI-driven customer experience or growth is a plus, not a requirement
  •  Most of all: you think of customers as guests, not data points, and you care about how a brand makes people feel. That instinct matters here more than any single tool on your CV.


Why Consider This Role?

  •  A direct partnership with the founders, on something they care about deeply
  • The chance to define a brand-new capability, on top of a foundation that is already built, so you are creating, not firefighting
  • Real influence over guest experience, loyalty, community, and growth across multiple brands
  •  A rare brief: use technology to make a beloved hospitality company more connected and more loved, without losing the warmth that built it


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn or write to work@allthingstalent.in

description: Job DescriptionIgnite your passion for product innovation by leading banker-centric development, inspiring solutions, and shaping the future with your strategic vision and influence.As a Product Director in the Branch Operations Product team, you are at the forefront of revolutionizing banker interactions. Our team is tasked with simplifying existing banker tools and introducing new banker tools to create a seamless experience for bankers and customers. You will lead innovation through the development of products and features that not only delight our bankers and customers but also empower our branch teams.In addition, this role will be responsible for managing all Executive budget related deliverables and controls across the Branch Operations Product, including but not limited to the Quarterly Investment Process, creating and monitoring self-inspection processes, managing access administration for the field and leading internal Audits within our space. Extensive technical, business and leadership experience is required to lead within the complex branch space. This position is ideal for an individual experienced in both Product and Program Management with excellent people management skills, strong organizational skills, an innovative mindset, risk and controls experience as well as strong analytical skills. Flexibility and comfort with ambiguity, given the rapid pace of change is required.Job ResponsibilitiesOversee the product roadmap, vision, development, execution, risk management, and business growth targets. Lead the entire product life cycle through planning, execution, and future development by continuously adapting, developing new products and methodologies, managing risks, and achieving business targets such as cost efficiency, feature enhancements, reusability, and reliability. Business Unit: EPSAutomotive Electronics

Role: Product Leader - Electrification

As a Product Leader – Electrification, you will own the strategy, technology roadmap and execution for our electrification product portfolio, mainly motor control units including inverters, motors etc. You will act as the strategic interface between OEM customers, engineering teams, and business leadership - shaping innovative, safe, and efficient solutions that accelerate the transition to sustainable mobility. This is a cross-functional leadership role that blends technical depth, customer engagement, and business strategy in a high-growth, fast-evolving domain.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Vision
  • Define and own the product strategy and technology roadmap for motor control units used in electric drive systems (eAxles, traction motors, hybrid drives) for India and global.
  • Analyze evolving EV architectures, regulations (emissions, homologation etc.), and OEM needs to guide feature prioritization.
  • Stay current with trends in e-motors, inverters, power electronics (SiC, GaN), and battery systems.
  • Collaborate with R&D teams on emerging technologies such as 800V architectures and thermal management optimization.
  • Analyze market trends, regulatory requirements (AIS, NCAP, ISO 26262, UNECE), and competitive products to guide feature prioritization.
  • Identify new business opportunities in ePowertrain and energy management solutions.
  • Develop clear value propositions and business cases for product investments.
  • Contribute to technology partnerships and innovation scouting.
  • Execution & Delivery
  • Translate user needs, customer/regulatroty/safety requirements into clear product goals and technology roadmaps & specifications.
  • Lead cross-functional teams (software, systems, hardware, validation) through the product lifecycle - from concept to SOP (Start of Production).
  • Prioritize features, manage trade-offs between performance, cost, and schedule.
  • Manage product lifecycle from concept through production and post-launch updates.
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Work closely with regulatory authorities, other tier1 stakeholders and internal stakeholders to align product goals and technology roadmaps.
  • Be the primary product interface to OEM customers - gather requirements, define specifications, and drive joint development programs.
  • Collaborate with sales and engineering teams to support RFQ (Request for Quotation) responses and define optimal product configurations.
  • Translate OEM requirements into clear internal product specifications and technical deliverables.
  • Collaborate with sales, engineering, and program management to ensure customer satisfaction and project success.
  • Present progress and outcomes to executive leadership and external partners.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and standards bodies.
  • Education
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Science Engineering.
  • MBA or certification in Product Management is an advantage.
  • Experience
  • 15+ years of experience in automotive product management, program management or systems engineering, including at least 3–5 years in electrification or ePowertrain.
  • Proven experience managing OEM customer programs at a Tier 1 supplier.
  • Deep understanding of high-voltage systems, power electronics, and vehicle integration.
  • Familiarity with ASPICE, AUTOSAR, and model-based development (MBSE).
  • Strong leadership and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with business priorities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Employee Service At Salesforce

Salesforce Employee Service powers next-generation internal support and service management. Our platform enables organizations to deliver seamless IT and HR experiences to their workforce by:

  • Automating internal service processes and streamlining cross-departmental workflows.
  • Leveraging AI to intelligently mine knowledge, resolve employee inquiries instantly, and power autonomous, agent-driven interactions.
  • Delivering exceptional employee experiences with intelligent case routing, predictive insights, and real-time collaboration tools that boost enterprise productivity.

About The Role

We’re seeking a visionary Director of Product Management to lead our next-generation AI initiatives and drive the strategy of AI-first, collaboration-first, and platform-centric innovations across our Employee Service portfolio (spanning IT Service Management and HR Service Delivery). This role is critical to building enterprise-grade internal service solutions that empower employees, IT helpdesks, and HR teams at scale.

You will lead the charge in transitioning our employee service paradigm from reactive ticketing to proactive, autonomous workflows. You will build and scale enterprise-grade Agentic AI systems, determining how autonomous agents collaborate with human employees, integrating state-of-the-art LLMs, and defining the future of AI-first work.

As the owner of the AI roadmap, you will translate the latest industry trends—spanning Generative AI and Predictive Machine Learning—into scalable product features. Working cross-functionally with engineering, data science, UX, sales, and marketing, you will ensure our AI solutions remain cutting-edge, secure, and highly impactful for transforming how enterprises support their workforce.

What You’ll Do

  • Define Product Strategy: Own the product vision and strategy for AI-driven capabilities within Employee Service (IT and HR domains), ensuring alignment with broader business goals.
  • Agentic AI Leadership: Lead the conceptualization and delivery of Agentic AI workflows, enabling autonomous, task-oriented AI agents to resolve internal IT tickets and HR requests.
  • Architectural Strategy: Drive product and architectural decisions around LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks. You will own the trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and context window optimization.
  • AI Trust, Safety & Evals: Design robust evaluation frameworks for AI agents to measure accuracy, mitigate hallucinations, manage prompt injection risks, and maintain enterprise-grade data privacy.
  • AI-First UX: Define the UX paradigms for human-in-the-loop (HITL) interactions, ensuring seamless handoffs between autonomous agents and employees/IT Teams.
  • Customer Discovery & Integration: Engage directly with enterprise customers to understand complex pain points, specifically focusing on how they discover, adopt, and integrate AI applications into their internal IT, HR, and custom enterprise ecosystems (e.g., via API-based integrations and secure server environments).
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate deeply with engineering, data science, and UX teams to build scalable, intuitive, and high-performance AI solutions, driving prioritization and trade-offs.
  • Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with sales, marketing, and enablement teams to define GTM strategies, positioning, and messaging to ensure successful product launches and market adoption.
  • Executive Communication: Regularly present product updates, AI strategies, and measurable results to C-suite leadership and external partners, ensuring continuous alignment.
  • Data-Driven Iteration: Leverage data-driven insights to continuously improve product offerings, tracking employee adoption, operational cost savings, and market share expansion.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 14+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, with a demonstrated track record of taking an Agentic product from 0-to-1 and scaling it in a production environment.
  • AI/ML Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with LLM orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), embedding models, vector databases, and designing autonomous agent loops (planning, tool use, reflection). You deeply understand the trade-offs between different foundation models and fine-tuning vs. RAG approaches. Strong working knowledge of predictive ML models and data pipelines.
  • Technical Fluency: Experience with AI evaluation techniques (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge) and continuous model improvement cycles based on human feedback. Ability to engage deeply with engineering and data science teams on architectural tradeoffs, model selection, and performance metrics.
  • Strategic Execution: Proven track record of developing and executing comprehensive, multi-quarter product roadmaps that drive measurable business impact.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to navigate stakeholder alignment and articulate complex AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Preferred Domain Knowledge: A proven ability to build scalable AI/LLM products is essential. Familiarity with Salesforce AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, Data Cloud) and prior experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), HR Service Delivery, or Employee Workflows are highly preferred but not mandatory.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions that transform internal support experiences for enterprises.
  • Collaborate with a world-class team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Shape the future of intelligent employee service management and drive meaningful impact by solving real organizational challenges at scale.
  • Be part of a culture of innovation, collaboration, personal growth and continuous learning.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Manager, Product Management-Technical

Overview

Are you a product management professional who wants to shape the cloud platform for Mastercard’s products? Do you want to work for a company that offers above and beyond benefits including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and even volunteer incentives? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your own professional learning and development?

ROLE

We are looking for seasoned Product Management professionals to join our team and help us build towards the future. Product Management-Technical (PM-T) are technical roles and work closely with Technical Program Managers, Software Design Engineers, User Experience, and internal customers to define the details behind the business requirements, the specifications, the user experience, and the API strategy for platform building blocks they own. Our PM-Ts use the Working Backwards process, which is all about is fleshing out the concept and achieving clarity of thought about what will ultimately be built. PM-Ts decompose the requirements into user stories, prioritizing the backlog, and defining the acceptance criteria. PM-Ts are in it for the long term, looking beyond the current project to become experts in their domain. They feed engineering a well groomed and backlog of user stories. They encourage re-use of their building blocks, continuously innovating on behalf of internal and external customers. As new capabilities are required, they will define its place in the platform ecosystem and write / prioritize the user stories to build the new block. When commercialization opportunities are identified for their building blocks, they will tee up ideas to the product development teams for further development.

All About You

  • Like to dive deep into the operational characteristics of the product
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with complete independence and autonomy
  • Experience defining and building cloud-native software products as a platform at scale
  • Proven track record of data driven decision making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across your team
  • Can debate the product merits with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers to make the right trade-off decisions
  • Experience in agile delivery methodologies (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
  • Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity
  • Ensures features and associated documentation are clear and easily consumable by other engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated experience building organizational relationships, partnering with and influencing teams while commanding the respect of the individuals on the team
  • Payments expertise a huge plus
  • BS/MBA in related discipline.
  • Product development experience


Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. With 1500+ customers in 60+ countries, strong product-market fit, and world-class investor support, we’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is building AI that transforms how the world's most sophisticated professionals work. We are looking for a Group Product Manager based in Bengaluru to drive the strategy, development, and delivery of Harvey's Knowledge Platform — the systems that connect Harvey to the legal world's content and tools. This means owning how we build and scale our ecosystem of third-party connectors and data partner integrations that bring rich legal context into Harvey, strengthening core user engagement. This is Harvey's first PM hire in India and a foundational role: you will own a critical product area end-to-end, work closely with our India Engineering team and cross-functional partners across time zones, and shape how Harvey builds and ships products. You will collaborate daily with Engineering, Design, Business Development, Legal Engineering, and GTM teams.

What You'll Do

  • Develop the product roadmap for Harvey's integrations and Knowledge Platform, defining vision, strategy, and priorities across document management systems, the legal tech connector ecosystem, and private legal data.
  • Partner closely with Harvey's India Engineering team to scope, design, and ship high-quality integrations and platform experiences at a rapid pace
  • Drive the strategy for expanding Harvey's connector ecosystem: integration aggregators and self-serve pathways that allow customers and partners to connect their own tools to Harvey at scale.
  • Work closely with business development to engage with partners and manage complex joint developments
  • Deeply understand the workflows of lawyers at leading law firms and in-house legal teams, translating that understanding into product decisions, especially around how enterprise knowledge (DMS files, matter data, firm content) flows into and shapes AI-powered workflows.
  • Act as a bridge between India and HQ (San Francisco / New York), ensuring tight communication loops and strategic alignment across sites.
  • Contribute to shaping Harvey's India product culture — setting the bar for how PMs operate in the region.

What You Have

  • 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or Senior PM level at a high-growth technology company.
  • Demonstrated ability to own and drive a product area end-to-end, from strategy through execution and iteration.
  • Strong technical fluency — you can have deep, substantive conversations with engineers about system design, data pipelines, API architecture, and infrastructure trade-offs, including topics like vector search, orchestration systems, and sync reliability.
  • Familiarity with enterprise SaaS go-to-market dynamics: customer commitments, partner integrations, access control and governance requirements, and the operational complexity of shipping to large law firms or regulated industries.
  • Track record of effective cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, GTM, and Customer Success — including navigating dependency-heavy roadmaps and partner relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to executives and external stakeholders with clarity and confidence.
  • Experience working in distributed or multi-site teams, with comfort operating across time zones.
  • Based in Bengaluru and eligible to work in India. Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in legal tech, professional services technology, or regulated industries.
  • Experience as a founding or early PM in a new-market or new-office setting.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI-native product design, and an intuition for how data quality and pipeline design affect AI output.

Additional Information

  • Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

The position requires deep expertise in AI/ML product development and a strong understanding of how generative AI systems behave in real-world production environments. You will work closely with engineering, design, QA, and go-to-market teams to deliver a highly technical and impactful enterprise product. This is a strategic, high-ownership role where you will shape how companies validate and improve conversational voice AI at scale. The environment is fast-paced, collaborative, and highly data-driven, with strong exposure to cutting-edge AI and voice technologies.

Accountabilities

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a Generative AI IVR testing platform aligned with business and customer needs.
  • Lead end-to-end product lifecycle activities including discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and post-release optimization.
  • Gather and translate customer, market, and stakeholder insights into clear product requirements, user stories, and success metrics.
  • Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to define evaluation frameworks, model performance benchmarks, and testing methodologies.
  • Work closely with engineering, design, QA, sales, and marketing teams to ensure successful delivery and go-to-market execution.
  • Drive product analytics and performance tracking using KPIs, dashboards, and customer feedback to inform data-driven decisions.
  • Own product documentation, compliance alignment, and launch readiness across global stakeholders.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years in a senior or lead Product Manager role.
  • Proven experience building and scaling B2B or B2C products in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AI/ML products, including understanding of model lifecycles, evaluation pipelines, and deployment considerations.
  • Deep familiarity with Generative AI concepts such as LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, and AI evaluation methodologies.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies and product tools such as Jira, Productboard, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker).
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to manage cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading product launches and go-to-market coordination.
  • Exposure to telephony systems, IVR platforms, or voice technologies (SIP, VoIP, Twilio, Genesys, Amazon Connect) is a strong advantage.
  • Background in SaaS, conversational AI, or enterprise voice platforms is highly desirable.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with experience and market standards.
  • Fully remote or hybrid flexibility within India.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge Generative AI and conversational voice technologies.
  • High-impact role with ownership over a strategic, fast-growing AI product.

descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Manager, Product Management (Transaction Processing)

Overview

This position is responsible for supporting the execution of the Mastercard Cross-Border Services Product Management roles and responsibilities. The Product manager works in conjunction with other cross functional teams and stakeholders to draft the business requirements for product development and complete all product and project readiness activities required to commercialize new features and functionalities.

Responsibilities Include

  • Act as an SME for all aspects of the product, leading and training internal stakeholders and regional partners on how the products works and why.
  • Analyze new product enhancement initiatives and define the product requirements.
  • Articulate and quantify market problems and defines opportunities leveraging our inherent capabilities and competence.
  • Provide thought leadership to create a compelling product vision for new Cross-Border offerings with enhanced capabilities and business value.
  • Accurately and concisely document new features and functionality for product and feature readiness activities.
  • Use Aha Road mapping tool to build product roadmap, prioritize and report on the Product Roadmap.
  • Partner with Product Owners to quantify and elaborate business requirements and ensure what is delivered meets the Product needs and requirements.
  • Adhere to the product development life cycle and include the Studio and P&E partnership principals to deliver all prioritized projects.
  • Test new features and functions utilizing available tools.


About You

  • An understanding of Cross-Border payment flow, API technology, payment initiation portals, SWIFT formats, FX management and compliance is required.
  • Must have excellent organization and product management skills.
  • Must be detail oriented and have excellent communication skills (both verbal and written)
  • Must be self-motivated, self-driven and drive tasks and projects to completion.
  • Proven ability to build working relationships efficiently and effectively with many diverse groups, in many different time zones.
  • Proven experience building and delivering product enhancements.
  • Business Analysis experience required.


Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Noora Health India Private Limited is a key partner in Noora Health’s mission is to improve outcomes and strengthen health systems by equipping family caregivers with the skills they need to care for their loved ones. They develop content, technology platforms, new products, and strengthen other operational functions that support the scale and impact of Noora Health’s programs.

Founded in 2014, Noora Health turns hospital hallways and waiting rooms into classrooms by tapping into the most compassionate resources available for the patient’s care: their own family.

With support from governments and partners in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal, Noora Health has trained more than 58 million caregivers and patients across 16,300+ facilities using their flagship caregiver education and training curriculum, the Care Companion Program (CCP).

In a cohort of patients, the CCP reduced post-surgical cardiac complications by 71%, maternal complications by 12%, newborn complications by 16%, and newborn mortality by 18%.

Noora Health is an Audacious Project Grantee and received the Skoll Foundation Award for Social Innovation. To learn more, watch our TED Talk, Skoll feature, or read about our partnership with the World Health Organization.

About The Role

The Mobile Care Companion (MCC) is Noora Health's primary digital touchpoint for family caregivers post discharge, serving ~50,000 users a day across India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal. It delivers behavior change and health system navigation at scale through two-way conversations, clinical triage, care coordination, and a growing set of AI-powered features.

This role owns MCC end-to-end: the caregiver experience, the health worker tools, the clinical workflows, and the AI layer that cuts across all of it. You will define what MCC becomes over the next three years, be accountable for both growth and outcomes, and lead an interdisciplinary team spanning product, clinical, data, and program functions to get there.

What You Will Do

  • Overall Model: Own the growth and operating model for MCC across user acquisition, activation, and retention at scale, including how MCC is positioned, priced, and deployed across government health systems and private partners
  • AI-led Product Experience: Reimagine the delivery with an AI-first thinking. Reason through where AI owns, where it assists, and where the experts jump in. Embed AI with an eval-led approach iterating to improve accuracy, engagement, and behavior change.
  • Product Roadmap: Set and execute the product roadmap to improve the user experience across the full funnel. Work with country program teams to translate local context (language, literacy, health system constraints) into product decisions that hold across four countries
  • Management & Execution: Deliver individually while also managing and mentoring a team of PMs, designers, clinicians across geographies.
  • Partnership & Advocacy: Represent the product with key internal and external stakeholders including health system partners, funders, leadership, and country teams to drive buy-in and unlock partnerships to drive MCC’s growth.

Who Are We Looking For

  • A 0-to-1 builder/founder: You have taken at least one product from concept to production to scale in a resource-constrained environment and owned its outcomes. You don't need scaffolding to get started
  • 6–12 years of product experience, with a meaningful share on AI-powered products; Hands-on fluency with LLMs: prompt design, retrieval architectures, eval pipelines, MCPs, and optimization workflows
  • Deeply data fluent and strong experimentation instinct: you obsesses about data, you define what good looks like before you build, and you are rigorous about measuring it
  • A first-principles thinker about complex service design. You are quick to build prototypes, sketch flows, write copies, and analyze and cut data to make your vision concrete
  • Able to work across clinical and technical teams, earn credibility with both, and translate between them clearly
  • Experience in healthcare, clinical tools, or other high-stakes domains is a strong plus

What We Value

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we understand the value of developing a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We prioritize diversity within our team, and we welcome candidates from all gender identities, castes, religious practices, sexual orientations, and abilities — among many others.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior Manager/Director of Platform Product Management (Security & Privacy)


Level: Senior Manager/Director


About the Role

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Mgr/Director of Platform Product Management – Security and Privacy to lead our security and privacy initiatives across our FICO platform. This role is pivotal in ensuring our platform meets the highest standards of security, compliance, and operational excellence without becoming a policing function. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in security architecture, IAM, data protection, cloud security, and compliance, and will collaborate cross-functionally to embed security into the platform's DNA.


Key Responsibilities

  • Security Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the platform’s security product strategy, aligning with business goals and regulatory and customer requirements.
  • Cryptographic Services: Lead platform key management systems (KMS), certificate lifecycle management, and PKI infrastructure, secrets management platforms and drive BYOK/HYOK and customer-controlled key capabilities.
  • Encryption & Data Protection: Define comprehensive encryption frameworks including at rest, in transit, and in use.
  • Privacy & Compliance: Implement privacy-by-design principles and ensure adherence to global privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA). Define requirements f. or FIPS 140-2, Common Criteria certification, and post-quantum cryptography readiness.
  • Security by Design: Collaborate with engineering, architecture, DevOps, and design teams to embed security into platform features and workflows from the ground up.
  • Operational Resilience: Define operational security practices including incident response, vulnerability management, and secure CI/CD pipelines.
  • Stakeholder Enablement & Metrics: Work with GTM teams to ensure security features are well-documented and leveraged in customer engagements. Define KPIs to measure platform security effectiveness.



Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of overall experience in the technology and security domains, with at least 7+ years specifically dedicated to Product Management for Security Products (e.g., Data Protection, IAM, Cloud Security, Vulnerability Management).
  • Hands-on experience with cryptographic services and secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault), PKI/Certificate lifecycle management, and threat modeling. Proficiency with secure API gateways and enterprise IAM providers including Okta, Auth0, AWS IAM, and Entra ID (Azure AD).
  • Deep understanding of IAM and security frameworks and protocols including OIDC, SAML, SCIM, OAuth, FIDO, RBAC/ABAC and KMIP
  • Strong understanding of DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and how security integrates into modern development workflows.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.

As the Defect Elimination AI Platform Sr. Product Manager, you would manage the development life cycle of our nascent technology in partnership with both a Product Leader and Engineering team. Mentorship & Career Growth

Key job responsibilities

  • Experience of managing complex business processes at scale.

  • Communication and influencing skills with an ability to deal with a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in defining, developing and using metrics to drive the vision and manage the business.
  • Analyze data and dive deep into processes to derive insights for enhancing systems
  • Ability to lead not only at the strategic level, but also tactically day-to-day by diving deeply into business and technical domains.

  • Ability to work effectively & independently in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines.

descriptionHtml:
AI Product Owner

Work mode: Remote

Notice period: Immediate joiners


So, what’s the role all about?

We are seeking an AI Product Owner to own and drive end-to-end internal AI initiatives across NiCE, turning AI from experimentation into measurable productivity gains. You will be the single accountable owner for internal AI transformation solutions that fundamentally change how core processes work across IT, HR, Finance, Sales, and other business functions. You will lead initiatives where AI agents significantly automate end-to-end processes (e.g., recruitment, finance operations, internal IT workflows), partnering with our internal AI delivery teams and business stakeholders to move from idea to live, adopted, value-generating AI solutions.


How will you make an impact?


You will own the full lifecycle of cross-functional AI initiatives: from opportunity framing through delivery, adoption, and measured outcomes. You will redesign business processes, translate business needs into actionable AI initiatives, and coordinate delivery with the IT AI Center of Excellence and business stakeholders.

This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong business analysis with project leadership, thrives on driving concrete outcomes under ambiguity, and is energized by leading AI transformation across multiple business areas.



Project Ownership & Accountability

  • Own the full lifecycle of cross-functional AI initiatives, from opportunity framing through production rollout, adoption, and measured impact
  • Act as the single accountable owner for each AI transformation solution, with dedicated focus and clear lines of accountability
  • Drive concrete outcomes even when the solution is evolving or exploratory at the start; manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment proactively

Business Process Leadership

  • Analyze business processes deeply; identify where AI agents can automate, accelerate, or rethink existing work
  • Translate business needs into actionable AI initiatives with clear scope, success metrics, owners, and timelines
  • Partner with Finance, HR, IT, Sales, and other functions to redesign processes around agent-driven automation
  • Work hand-in-hand with the IT AI Center of Excellence

Outcomes & Impact

  • Partner with the AI analysts to define and report measurable impact: hours saved, cycle-time reduction, deflection, adoption, and ROI
  • Ensure every initiative reaches production with documented handover to operations and ongoing ownership


Have you got what it takes?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience as a technical project manager/product manager with proven business analysis capabilities, of which at least 1 year was hands-on with AI projects
  • Familiarity with Anthropic Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar agent platforms
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, automation, and how AI reshapes the way processes are designed
  • Experience with leading complex, cross-functional projects, ideally combining transformation, automation, or digital programs
  • Demonstrated experience leading products that change how a process works, not only deliver software

  • Skills & Competencies:

    • Analyst + PM hybrid: strong business process analysis combined with product leadership - able to map a process end-to-end and drive its transformation
    • Comfort leading initiatives where the solution is evolving; able to drive toward concrete outcomes under ambiguity
    • Strong stakeholder management across business and technology functions, up to executive level
    • Excellent written and verbal communication; full professional fluency in English


    Regards,

    Aravindhan
