descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Fleet Management based in India.

This role is focused on defining and shaping the product experience for fleet management solutions used by thousands of operators, dispatchers, and drivers across diverse industries.

The position plays a critical role in translating complex operational challenges into simple, scalable, and data-driven digital workflows that improve safety, efficiency, and cost management.

It involves owning end-to-end product strategy, from roadmap definition to execution, in close collaboration with engineering, design, data science, and go-to-market teams.

The role operates at the intersection of physical operations and advanced technology, leveraging AI and large-scale data to build intelligent fleet management capabilities.

It requires strong analytical thinking, customer empathy, and the ability to align global stakeholders around a unified product vision.

This is a high-impact opportunity to build products that directly influence real-world logistics, transportation, and operational efficiency at scale.

Accountabilities

  • Define and own the product roadmap for key fleet management capabilities, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • Translate customer pain points into intuitive web and mobile product experiences that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Collaborate with data science teams to transform large-scale telemetry and sensor data into actionable AI-powered product features.
  • Establish clear success metrics, run experiments, launch beta versions, and iterate based on user feedback and performance data.
  • Partner with engineering, design, sales, marketing, and support teams to deliver cohesive product experiences across global markets.
  • Engage directly with customers, including dispatchers, drivers, and operations teams, to gather insights and validate product decisions.
  • Use data analysis and dashboards to drive product decisions and measure impact on safety, cost, and performance outcomes.

Requirements

  • 4-7 years of experience in B2B product management with ownership of end-to-end product areas.
  • Strong track record of delivering product features that improve operational efficiency, safety, cost, or system uptime.
  • Ability to analyze data, work with dashboards, and use metrics to guide product decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to align diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders across regions.
  • Experience working with logistics, fleet management, telematics, automotive systems, or industrial IoT is a strong plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a user-centric and data-driven mindset.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced environments with multiple competing priorities.
  • Experience working with cross-functional global teams is highly desirable.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with experience and market standards.
  • Opportunity to build and scale impactful fleet management products used globally.
  • Exposure to AI-driven product development and large-scale operational data systems.
  • Remote-friendly work environment based in India.
  • Strong career growth opportunities in a high-impact product organization.
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture working across global teams.
  • Opportunity to directly influence real-world logistics and operational efficiency.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner | Senior based in India .

This is a senior product ownership role at the intersection of hardware and software, focused on building a unified productivity ecosystem designed to help users eliminate distractions and improve focus. You will own the end-to-end product experience across a smart physical device, mobile and desktop applications, and a growing set of integrations and automation capabilities. The role requires strong product judgment and the ability to turn complex, fast-moving inputs into clear priorities and executable plans. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, and cross-functional teams to ensure product coherence across all surfaces. Success in this role means shaping not just features, but a cohesive system that drives activation, retention, and long-term engagement. The environment is fast-evolving, highly experimental, and deeply user-focused, with significant ownership and autonomy from day one.

Accountabilities

  • Own and evolve the product as a unified ecosystem spanning hardware, mobile apps, desktop applications, and integrations, ensuring consistent user experience across all surfaces.
  • Define, structure, and prioritize the product roadmap, translating feedback, data, and strategic goals into clear delivery plans.
  • Design and refine key user journeys such as focus modes, timers, distraction blocking, status systems, and automation workflows.
  • Align hardware and software behavior to ensure seamless interaction between device, applications, and third-party integrations.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and design teams to define requirements, user flows, and acceptance criteria for new features.
  • Monitor product performance metrics including activation, retention, engagement, and repeat usage, using insights to guide prioritization.
  • Coordinate product direction across design, engineering, marketing, support, and operations to maintain a coherent product vision.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, or Product Leadership roles with end-to-end responsibility for digital products.
  • Strong ability to operate at the intersection of hardware and software, with an understanding of system-level product design.
  • Proven experience turning ambiguous inputs into structured roadmaps, priorities, and clear product requirements.
  • Comfortable working with technical concepts such as APIs, integrations, device behavior, and cross-platform architecture.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to write precise, structured, and actionable product documentation.
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers and designers in agile, fast-paced environments.
  • Strong product judgment grounded in user behavior, data, and practical constraints rather than intuition alone.
  • Ability to protect focus and ensure roadmap discipline in complex, fast-moving product environments.
  • Nice-to-have: experience with consumer hardware, productivity tools, behavioral UX, automation, or community-driven products.

Benefits

  • Fully remote work from anywhere in the world.
  • Provided equipment to ensure a productive and comfortable work setup.
  • Benefits package including private healthcare (VHI), corporate sports programs, language courses, and therapy support.
  • Flexible working model with a five-day workweek and adaptable start times.
  • Opportunity to build and scale a category-defining productivity ecosystem spanning hardware and software.

Job Description

As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for translating business objectives into actionable product features. This role involves managing the product roadmap, collaborating closely with stakeholders, and ensuring smooth execution. Your expertise in Agile methodologies and stakeholder management will be key to delivering high-quality products.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the product roadmap, ensuring timely and effective delivery.
  • Refine the backlog, prioritize tasks, and write clear user stories with measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, development teams, and QA to deliver exceptional features.
  • Present clear, focused updates to stakeholders and leadership, keeping them informed.
  • Act as the primary liaison, fostering a shared understanding between business and technology teams.
  • Synthesize stakeholder inputs into well-defined priorities and decisions.
  • Support Agile ceremonies, promoting an iterative delivery approach.
  • Ensure delivery plans align with hardware dependencies and vendor timelines when applicable.
  • Translate business requirements into user stories, considering business value and constraints.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Owner, Manager, or Analyst roles with delivery ownership.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum teams in iterative delivery environments is a must.
  • Experience with hardware-involved products and vendor coordination is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of business objectives and their translation into product requirements.
  • Ability to prioritize work based on business value, stakeholder needs, and delivery constraints.
  • Proven track record in translating business requirements into user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a focus on collaboration.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments with multiple teams.
  • Proficiency in Agile tools like Linear, Jira, and Azure DevOps, and documentation platforms.
  • Experience with planning and presentation tools such as PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Miro.

About Us

At Zensar, we’re “experience-led everything”. We are committed to conceptualizing, designing, engineering, marketing, and managing digital solutions and experiences for over 130 leading enterprises. We are a company driven by a bold purpose: Together, we shape experiences for better futures. Whether for our clients, our people, or the world around us, this belief powers everything we do. At the heart of our culture is ONE with Client - a set of four core values that reflect who we are and how we work: One Zensar, Nurturing, Empowering, and Client Focus.

Part of the $4.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Explore Life at Zensar and join us to Grow. Own. Achieve. Learn. to be the best version of yourself.

We believe the best work happens when individuality is celebrated, growth is encouraged, and well-being is prioritized. We are an equal employment opportunity (EEO) and affirmative action employer, committed to creating an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, marital status, family medical leave status, or protected veteran status.

Job Ad

Senior Manager, Software Engineering

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Software Engineering to join Procore's Customer Adoption team in Bangalore, a new team with a mission to develop experiences that help customers achieve their outcomes with Procore's products. Procore software solutions aim to improve the lives of everyone in construction, and the people within Product & Technology are the driving force behind our innovative, top-rated global platform. We're a customer-centric group that encompasses engineering, product, product design and data, security, and business systems.

In this Senior Manager role, you'll hire, lead, and grow a high-performing software engineering team responsible for shaping the end-to-end onboarding and adoption experience for Procore customers worldwide. You'll set the technical direction across both front-end and back-end services, with a particular focus on building customer-facing experiences and robust APIs that integrate with Data and AI platforms. You'll drive delivery of high-impact features, continuously raise the bar on performance, scalability, and reliability, and partner closely with Product, Design, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, and Customer Success leaders to define technical architecture, scope, and execution. Along the way, you'll mentor engineers and tech leads to do their best work and excel in their careers.

What you'll do

  • Lead and grow a full stack engineering team in Bangalore, including managing senior engineers and tech leads, and supporting their professional and technical growth through coaching, performance reviews, and career development.
  • Own the technical strategy and delivery roadmap for the Adoption and Onboarding team's full stack services and customer-facing experiences, in close partnership with Product and Design leadership.
  • Drive architecture and design decisions across the front-end and back-end stack, with deep ownership of application design, versioning, performance, and experience for both internal and external consumers.
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering and Machine Learning teams to integrate data pipelines, models, and AI-powered features into the onboarding and adoption experience, ensuring clean contracts, reliable delivery, and strong observability across system boundaries.
  • Ensure backend services are scalable, secure, observable, and aligned with Procore-wide Engineering direction and platform standards.
  • Lead engineering-led initiatives that improve developer productivity, code quality, and platform health, and challenge the status quo when better approaches exist.
  • Champion the responsible and effective adoption of AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor, and similar) across your team, establishing best practices for productivity, code review, and quality.
  • Partner with peer Engineering Managers and Senior Managers globally to align on cross-team initiatives, dependencies, and shared platform decisions.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs and SLOs for the team's services and APIs, and ensure a strong incident response posture so customer-impacting issues are resolved quickly.
  • Communicate clearly and frequently with engineering leadership on operational performance, delivery progress, risks, and strategic initiatives.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and innovative team culture where engineers feel supported, challenged, and able to do their best work.

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager leading high-performing software teams, including experience managing senior engineers or tech leads.
  • 8+ years of experience as a software engineer building data-intensive applications and scalable backend services.
  • Strong hands-on background and current proficiency across the full stack, with deep experience in React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating REST and GraphQL APIs at scale, including schema design, performance optimization, authentication, and API lifecycle management.
  • Proven track record of partnering with Data Engineering and Machine Learning teams to ship production features, including integrating data pipelines, model serving, and ML-driven experiences into customer-facing products.
  • Demonstrated experience adopting AI coding tools (for example Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) in a production engineering environment, and a clear point of view on how to use them to improve team velocity and quality.
  • Experience managing globally distributed teams and partnering across time zones, with a passion for helping engineers grow their careers.
  • Proven track record of close collaboration with Product and Design to shape roadmaps and execution plans for customer-facing products.
  • Strong grasp of the full software development lifecycle, including CI/CD, testing strategy, deployment, runtime platforms, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Experience operating in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Job Description

As a Technical Product Owner II here at Honeywell, you will lead and mentor a team of Technical Product Owners, providing strategic guidance and overseeing the entire product development lifecycle. Collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product managers and engineers, will be a key aspect of your role, ensuring a cohesive approach to product development. Your strategic influence will extend to driving innovation within the product management function, identifying opportunities for technological advancements, and actively participating in strategic decision-making to shape the overall direction of the Technical Product Owner team.

In this role, you will impact Honeywell's position at the forefront of technological advancements by driving efficient and timely product development, contributing to continuous improvement and innovation, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that meet customer needs.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define and prioritize technical requirements
  • Drive the development of technical specifications and ensure alignment with overall product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance to the development team throughout the product lifecycle
  • Work closely with the Technical Product Owner Manager to ensure timely and successful product delivery
  • Actively participate in product planning and roadmap discussions

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 2+ years of experience in a Technical Product Owner management role or similar technical leadership position
  • Mastery understanding of software development methodologies and processes
  • Experience working in agile development environments and familiarity with agile principles
  • Proven track record of successfully managing technical teams

WE VALUE

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or another related field.
  • Certifications in product management or agile methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving capability

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

Job Description

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

About The Job

At Sanofi, we’re committed to providing the next-gen healthcare that patients and customers need. The Digital Launch & Market Product team ( LMP) is one of the key vertical towers within Digital R&D, includes product line teams to serve global regulatory Affairs ( GRA), Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV), R&D CMO/Medical etc. domains. We focus on delivery of innovative digital products to support and accelerate product launches, accelerating cycle times to bring medicines to patients faster while improving operational efficiency and ensure regulatory compliance.

This position operates within Sanofi Digital R&D - Digital Launch & Market Product (LMP) - Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV) Product Line whose mission is to help improve Patient Safety with AI and automation enabled Digital Solutions.

As Digital Product Owner, you will be accountable to: Define - strategy and roadmap, Drive - delivery and management, Measure - value and impact of the Digital Product.

Main Responsibilities –

  • Product Vision
    • Set and communicate - the vision for the product, working closely with Digital and Business Leadership and key stakeholders.
    • Ensure vision is aligned with Company strategic direction.
    • Manage strong relationships and partnerships with Digital R&D verticals and across Business functions, that interact with Portfolio management and decision-making.
    • Stay current in industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in Product management.
    • Identify opportunities for process improvement using AI and automation.
    • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the product team
  • Product Delivery
    • Define clear and actionable goals to deliver incremental value.
    • Lead delivery of Product from conception, MVP(minimum viable product) through continuous improvements.
    • Define, implement and lead Governance around the Digital Product - to ensure best practices are followed, prioritizations aligned, value realized, risks managed.
    • Ensure collaboration with the architecture, Digital Data and AI, and digital R&D Data Product and Platform teams
    • Ensure Agile framework and methodologies are followed, to deliver incremental value.
    • Manage backlog prioritization, balancing short-term deliverables with long-term goals and breakthrough ideas.
    • Champion modern AI tooling to accelerate design, testing, and iteration.
  • Product Value
    • Ensure AI-driven insights, automated workflows are integrated in the product and aligns with user journey – data, process, people.
    • Drive user adoption by delivering intuitive, user-centric solutions. Gathering regular feedback, monitoring usage metrics, user satisfaction.
    • Ensure each sprint delivers measurable improvements to cycle times, internal productivity, quality and compliance, user experience.
    • Deliver Continuous improvement in changing digital landscape, regulatory requirements and business strategy.
    • Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases
About You

Education & Experience:

  • 10+ IT industry experience with 5+ years of experience working in Digital Product delivery and leadership as a product owner or product manager
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or STEM related field. Master degree is preferred.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical industry with knowledge of pharmaceutical Drug lifecycle, R&D value chain.
  • Functional and technical expertise in the Pharmacovigilance ( PV) domain is highly desirable.
  • Experience of software development in a GxP regulated environment is a strong plus.

Key Skills

  • Expertise in leading cross-functional teams to create Digital Strategies and Implementation roadmaps. Distinctive focus on solution objectives and application of product methodologies.
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical designs and solutions, with a strong business and technical acumen
  • Experienced in complex solution implementation & delivery in agile.
  • Demonstrated track record of designing, developing, and delivering transformative digital products – particularly in the AI space is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases
  • Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases
  • Strong technical/functional background, with the ability to understand and communicate complex functional/technical concepts.
  • Solid knowledge and experience of Lean & Agile practices, UX/UI and Application Design & Integration

About Persistent

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026.

About Position

We are hiring a Product Owner with strong Lending (LOS) domain expertise to drive product vision, prioritize features, and lead Agile delivery. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful solutions, ensuring seamless product execution and enhanced customer experience in a fast-paced fintech environment. Please mention a brief description of the position.

  • Role: Product Owner
  • Location: Any PSL Location
  • Experience: 6 to 10 Years
  • Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do

  • Assess business value, develop business cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes aligned with product vision and strategic goals.
  • Define and manage product deliveries, release plans, and feature scope in collaboration with platform leadership.
  • Draft product objectives and strategies, leveraging data-driven insights for decision-making.
  • Define and track KPIs; utilize analytics, A/B testing, and user feedback to refine product features.
  • Convert functional specifications into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog; lead backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions.
  • Manage release planning and track progress through development and QA phases in collaboration with the Scrum Master.
  • Lead software gate reviews, including formal and informal handoffs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on product visioning and concept development.
  • Translate complex sprint outcomes and technical updates into business-friendly summaries.
  • Act as the voice of the customer across engineering, UX, QA, and business teams.
  • Proactively identify and escalate risks and impediments to program leadership.
  • Ensure understanding of end-to-end customer experience, integrations, and technical dependencies.
  • Drive continuous improvement in product development practices.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented culture with shared accountability.

Expertise You'll Bring

  • Experience working as a Product Owner or in a similar role within software product development.
  • Strong domain knowledge in Lending (LOS mandatory) and familiarity with LMS systems.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban); SAFe experience is a plus.
  • Proven ability to write clear user stories and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering, QA, UX, and cross-functional teams.
  • Product Owner certification preferred; Scrum Master certification is an added advantage.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced English communication skills (B2+ or higher).
  • Prior experience in FinTech is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  • We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
  • Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
  • If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers

“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”

Job Title: Product Manager – Cash & Liquidity Management

Position Summary

LPL Financial is seeking an execution-focused Product Manager to lead initiatives within our Cash Management domain, including capabilities such as Payments (ACH, FedNow, Zelle, Debit), 3rdparty Banking & Retirement. This role is responsible for defining and delivering solutions that enhance the advisor and client experience, ensure operational efficiency, and support the firm’s broader financial ecosystem. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial services, product lifecycle management, and cross-functional leadership. This role requires a balance of delivery thinking, technical understanding and hands-on execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the execution of roadmap items for Cash Management capabilities.
  • Lead product discovery and solutioning in partnership with advisors, service teams, operations, and technology.
  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Collaborate with Agile delivery teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution.
  • Partner with Service and Operations to ensure readiness and support for new capabilities.
  • Communicate product strategy, progress, and outcomes to stakeholders across the organization.
  • Ensure alignment with compliance, risk, and regulatory requirements.

Key Success Metrics

  • Advisor Adoption & Satisfaction: Increase in usage and positive feedback from advisors on cash movement tools.
  • Feature Delivery: Timely release of roadmap items with minimal delays or scope changes.
  • Operational Efficiency: Reduction in manual interventions and service tickets related to cash movement.
  • Quality Assurance: Low defect rates and high success rates in incremental testing and production validation.
  • Time-to-Market: Improved cycle time from ideation to release.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Positive stakeholder feedback and strong collaboration across Product, Tech, Service, and Operations.
  • Compliance Readiness: Successful integration of regulatory and risk requirements into product design and delivery.
  • Innovation Pipeline: Number of new ideas validated and moved into development.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Technology, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of product management experience in financial services or FinTech, specifically Retirement and Payments.
  • Strong SDLC & technical background (SQL, CI/CD, UX design, AWS & Cloud)
  • Strong background in payments, banking, risk, compliance
  • Strong Agile background influencing cross functional teams to use best practices
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with advisor workflows, service operations, and compliance frameworks.
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into scalable product solutions.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision-making.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Wealth platforms; CRM platforms, account onboarding solutions, advisor portals, and financial integrations.
  • Experience with Broker Dealer or Large Retail bank systems.

descriptionHtml:
The Senior Product Owner works to fulfill the strategic product roadmap established by the Product Management leadership team and meet business objectives. The person in this position manages multiple teams and backlogs for more than one product and/or for more complex products. This role is responsible for defining the detailed product deliverables. The Senior Product Owner must have a firm understanding of the business domain and product needs taking into account multiple types of users utilizing each solution. This position works closely with engineering on the specifications to ensure their Agile teams have all of the information needed to deliver a product that provides maximum value to the users.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Product Managers to understand the market demands, priorities, and overall product strategy.
  • Partner with UX and Product Managers on market research efforts to understand and prioritize customer needs.
  • Work with one or more engineering teams to deliver timely, quality releases that provide high business value and exceed customer expectations.
  • Flexibility to support more than one product within a portfolio, potentially across value streams
  • Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes
  • Work with the Product Manager and Agile team to define the scope included in a release.
  • Understand user personas and partner with UX to develop
  • Create detailed specifications/requirements for the product features so they are clearly understood by the development team.
  • Write user stories and establish acceptance criteria in collaboration with the team.
  • Actively participate in PI planning, product sprints and daily stand-up meetings
  • Research and clarify details as the team develops the application
  • Be aware of customer commitments in order to communicate internally to assist with managing team expectations
  • Manage dependencies in and across sprints and releases
  • Work with the Agile team to manage and prioritize the backlog to ensure alignment with changing business needs.
  • Prioritize support work as needed
  • Assist with system status communication and escalation as needed including customer communication
  • Perform demos to all stakeholders on a regular basis
  • Keep stakeholders apprised of progress and incorporate their feedback
  • Understand project budgets, scope and timelines and work to maintain a balance
  • Use metrics and feedback to improve team and organization processes, best practices, performance, and delivery
  • May provide work direction or guidance to colleagues with less experience
  • Act as a product champion within the company

Skills Required

  • 7+ years’ proven experience as a Quality Engineer.
  • Experience with testing tools such as WebDriverIO/ any UI Automation tool , Postman, ReadyAPI / RestSharp/ any API automation tool.
  • Proficiency in languages like TypeScript, Groovy, or Java.
  • Extensive experience testing APIs/web services (REST, SOAP, etc.) using Postman.
  • Knowledge of AWS services (S3, Athena, DynamoDB, Kubernetes, Secrets Manager).
  • Experience with test management tools like Azure DevOps and Zephyr.
  • Proven experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments.
  • Experience using GitHub for version control.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous learning mindset with a willingness to adapt to new technologies.

Honeywell's Value Engineering (VE) and Component Engineering (CE) Center of Excellence (COE) is a dynamic collective of professionals dedicated to refining product development through innovative engineering and strategic component selection.

You will be part of Honeywell's VE/CE CoE Advanced Tech team driving Tech Charter & Strategy with focus on how AI/ML can enable us meet VE/CE revenue targets.

You will be driving requirements for AI solutions, outside-in product thinking, conceptualization, and feature scaling for solutions that improve product cost, component strategy, reuse, and business impact. You will own AI product enhancement and roadmap prioritization by partnering with engineering, VECE SMEs, and business stakeholders to convert user requirements into structured features and measurable value realization.

The role drives alignment across VECE, hardware engineering, and AI delivery teams, ensuring solutions are functionally relevant, technically feasible, and scalable across programs and product lines.

The ideal candidate brings 15+ years of experience, prior VECE program exposure, strong business understanding, and a hardware engineering foundation to shape high-impact AI product feature decisions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive end-to-end AI product requirements for VECE use cases by translating business priorities, user feedback, and engineering needs into clear functional requirements and product backlog items.
  • Bring an outside-in perspective to identify AI driven opportunities in value engineering, component optimization, reuse, and feature adoption that improve cost, quality, and business outcomes.
  • Lead AI product conceptualization and feature scaling for VECE-related solutions, ensuring alignment with user workflows, program priorities, and enterprise impact.
  • Prioritize AI enhancements and roadmap decisions based on value realization, implementation feasibility, business case strength, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Partner closely with VECE SMEs, hardware engineering teams, business stakeholders, and AI delivery teams to ensure solutions are relevant, scalable, and operationally effective.
  • Develop business and functional competency plans for delivery teams so they can better understand VECE processes, user pain points, and expected business outcomes.
  • Leverage prior VECE program experience to drive governance, stakeholder alignment, adoption, and continuous improvement across product features and delivery execution.

Skills

 QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of experience, including VECE program exposure, strong business acumen, and expertise in product requirements management.
  • Deep product ownership capability, including requirements shaping, feature definition, backlog prioritization, and roadmap decision-making across complex technical environments.
  • Strong VECE functional knowledge, with clear understanding of value engineering, component strategy, cost optimization, reuse opportunities, and business value realization.
  • Ability to translate business problems and user needs into structured functional requirements, scalable product concepts, and adoption-ready features.
  • Strong hardware engineering foundation to understand product architecture, technical feasibility, engineering constraints, and cross-functional trade-offs.
  • Excellent business acumen and outcome orientation, with the ability to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills to align VECE SMEs, engineering teams, business leaders, and AI delivery teams around common product goals.
  • Ability to build functional clarity and delivery readiness by enabling teams with domain context, governance discipline, and clear success measures for product adoption.

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

descriptionHtml:
Role Summary:-

The Product Owner is responsible for managing complex business requirements, driving solution discussions, and ensuring successful delivery of product capabilities across domains and systems.

The role requires strong product thinking, insurance domain expertise, and the ability to operate effectively in AI-enabled delivery environments. The Product Owner is expected to leverage AI-assisted workflows to improve speed, quality, traceability, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration.

The Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R&D, responsible for managing requirements for complex features in the system. The candidate should be able to run workshops with domain managers, Product Managers, and customers to elicit requirements, present solution designs, and take requirements through to implementation.

Pre-requisites

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT preferred) or equivalent qualification.
  • MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 6–9 years of relevant experience.
  • Should have some technical experience before transitioning to a BA/Product role.
  • Insurance or BFSI experience is a must.
  • Prior knowledge of Core Insurance is a must.
  • Experience of having worked in at least one implementation project.
  • Led end-to-end requirements for at least 2 modules.

Key Responsibilities

 Product & Requirement Ownership

  • Gather business requirements for medium to complex features and interfaces in the system (Contact/Policy, Claims/Accounting/Interfaces).
  • Document requirements in SDS.
  • Analyse and prioritize defects.
  • Conduct requirement discussions with Product Managers, Domain Managers, and customers.
  • Conduct walkthroughs of requirements with development and QA teams.
  • Attend daily stand-ups.
  • Conduct User Forums.
  • Conduct training sessions for junior members of the team.
  • Work as a core representative to project teams as needed.
  • Convert business requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Drive end-to-end solution discussions across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Delivery teams.
  • Perform impact analysis across modules, systems, and business processes.
  • Prioritize backlog items aligned to business outcomes and roadmap objectives.
  • Ensure traceability from business requirements to implementation and validation.
  • Support product roadmap execution and release planning.

AI-Enabled Responsibilities

  • Use AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, documentation, prioritization, and workshop preparation.
  • Use AI-assisted techniques for: story generation, acceptance criteria generation, process mapping, impact analysis, test scenario generation, SQL/query generation, knowledge retrieval, and defect analysis.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, feasibility, traceability, hallucinations, and bias.
  • Use AI-enabled insights to improve delivery efficiency and decision-making.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, templates, and AI-assisted delivery assets.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled ways of working within teams.
  • Apply responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, privacy, and human oversight.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong understanding of insurance processes and core insurance systems.
  • Experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Solution Design.
  • Ability to manage complex cross-functional requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and prioritization capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise systems.
  • Excellent analytical skills and good design skills.
  • Intermediate SQL and data modelling skills (mandatory).
  • Understanding of SDLC and Agile concepts (mandatory).
  • Very good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to document business requirements as user stories; break large epics into smaller features and stories and document them in SDS.
  • Ability to conduct demos and walkthroughs with POs and business users.
  • Techno-functional and business solutioning capability.
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI-enabled delivery tools.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AI-enabled delivery platforms and workflows.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Exposure to digital transformation initiatives.
  • Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and orchestration-based workflows.

Key Characteristics

  • Outcome-oriented mindset.
  • Strong ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to balance speed with quality and governance.
  • Systems thinking and cross-domain understanding.
  • Coaching and mentoring mindset.

Senior Product Manager

Full-Time | Product & Technology | Remote (India Only) / Hybrid

About The Role

AI/ML Experience Required Telephony Knowledge a Plus

We are building a cutting-edge platform that tests Generative AI-based Interactive Voice Response (IVR) systems through real, automated phone calls — helping enterprises validate, benchmark, and improve their AI-powered voice experiences before they reach end customers. This is a high-impact space at the intersection of conversational AI, telephony, and quality engineering.

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end product lifecycle — from vision and strategy through discovery, delivery, and post-launch optimization. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, design, QA, sales, and marketing, and will play a pivotal role in shaping a product that sits at the forefront of AI-driven communication testing.

The ideal candidate has direct, hands-on experience managing AI/ML products and a strong intuition for how large language models and generative AI systems behave in production. Familiarity with telephony infrastructure and IVR systems will set you apart.

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy & Vision

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Gen AI IVR testing platform, aligned with business goals.
  • Act as the voice of the customer while balancing long-term product scalability.
  • Monitor product performance using KPIs, analytics, and customer feedback to make data-driven decisions.

Discovery & Requirements

  • Gather, analyze, and prioritize requirements from clients, prospects, and internal stakeholders.
  • Translate customer needs and market insights around AI/ML and conversational voice systems into clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Lead product discovery, validation, and feature definition using data and customer feedback.
  • Prioritize the product backlog to balance customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, QA, sales, and marketing teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Partner with AI/ML engineers to define model evaluation criteria, testing frameworks, and performance benchmarks.
  • Conduct internal product demos and walkthroughs for stakeholders prior to customer release.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations across regions and time zones.
  • Drive successful product launches and coordinate go-to-market activities.

Documentation, Compliance & Launch Readiness

  • Own and maintain comprehensive product documentation, ensuring it is accurate, up to date, and accessible.
  • Ensure product compliance with regional regulations, security standards, and client requirements.
  • Ensure product readiness by aligning documentation, training, and release materials before launch.
  • Make data-driven decisions to improve product adoption, usability, and customer satisfaction.

What You BringRequired Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead PM role.
  • Proven track record of defining and shipping successful B2B or B2C products at scale.
  • Hands-on experience managing AI/ML products — you understand model lifecycles, evaluation pipelines, and the nuances of shipping AI-powered features to production. (Must Have)
  • Familiarity with Generative AI concepts including LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, and AI evaluation/testing methodologies.
  • Strong ability to write clear, concise product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and backlog management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Redmine).
  • Excellent analytical skills — comfortable working with data, dashboards, and product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker).
  • Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present to diverse audiences.
  • Experience owning go-to-market coordination and product launch activities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of telephony systems, IVR platforms, and voice infrastructure (e.g., SIP, VoIP, Twilio, Genesys, Avaya, Amazon Connect) is a significant advantage. (Big Plus)
  • Experience with QA, testing, or DevOps tooling for AI systems.
  • Background in SaaS, conversational AI, contact centre, or enterprise voice platforms.
  • Experience with compliance-sensitive products (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, regional data regulations).
  • Experience working in globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) strategies.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus, but not required.

descriptionHtml:
About Us
At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living while reducing emissions. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies.

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about our What and our Why and how we can work together.

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market-development activities.

The Global Business Center - Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

What Will You Do
A Product Advisor helps drive product value and long-term success by bringing business, IT, and vendors together and giving guidance on priorities and direction. They support the product owner with shaping the backlog and help the delivery team focus on what matters most and delivers real impact. They help balance keeping things stable with making continuous improvements, encourage better ways of working, and make sure the product grows and adapts with business needs.

The position is located at ExxonMobil’s office in Bengaluru.

For asset forward S&OP the Product is Maestro Maestro is a global supply chain planning system for Fuels, supporting planning, optimization, and decision-making across the regions.

Capability Development
  • Support the Product Owner in clarifying business needs, priorities, and improvement opportunities.
  • Act as a liaison between business and technology stakeholders to ensure clear communication of objectives, progress, risks, and dependencies.
  • Build and maintain strong understanding of business processes, product capabilities, and analytics use cases to support decision making.
  • Help align stakeholders around shared understanding of scope, outcomes, and capability intent.
  • Apply domain expertise in Fuels Supply–Demand balancing processes and Maestro platform capabilities.
  • Translate Fuels planning and optimization needs into Maestro-relevant capability insights.

Product Delivery & Value Enablement
  • Partner with the Product Owner to define, refine, and deliver product capabilities.
  • Support solution quality across data accuracy, performance, availability, and usability.
  • Gather feedback to identify improvement opportunities and support adoption and value realization.
  • Contribute to roadmap development, ensuring alignment with business priorities and long-term goals.
  • Support validation of delivered solutions against business requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Align roadmap inputs with Fuels planning cycles and Maestro capability evolution.
  • Validate solutions against Supply–Demand balancing use cases and planning requirements.

Backlog, Agile & Cross-Team Support
  • Support backlog readiness by refining epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Provide input to prioritization, balancing business value, strategic alignment, and capacity.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies to ensure clarity, alignment, and informed decision-making.
  • Help identify and manage risks, dependencies, and impediments, coordinating across teams where needed.
  • Assist in evaluating unplanned requests to protect delivery focus and commitments.
  • Incorporate Maestro-specific context (e.g., optimization logic, data pipelines, integration dependencies) into backlog refinement.

About You
Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Analytics, or related field.
  • ~5+ years experience in product support, business analysis, or supply chain/analytics roles.
  • Experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate issues, identify improvement opportunities, and take initiative independently to drive solutions across products and systems
  • Strong collaboration and excellent communication skills.
  • Digital mind-set with problem solving skills Ability to translate business needs into product requirements
  • Experience in Supply–Demand balancing, Fuels, or downstream supply chain
  • Familiarity with Maestro or similar planning/optimization tools

Your Benefits
An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Medical plans, maternity leave and benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment benefits
  • Retirement benefits
  • Global networking & cross-functional opportunities
  • Annual vacations & holidays
  • Day care assistance program
  • Training and development program
  • Tuition assistance program
  • Workplace flexibility policy
  • Relocation program
  • Transportation facility

Please note benefits may change from time to time without notice, subject to applicable laws. The benefits programs are based on the Company’s eligibility guidelines.

descriptionHtml:
Role: Product Owner – Commercial Lines

Experience: 10-15 Years

Location: Pune / Mumbai

Reporting To: Head – Product Delivery


Role Summary

The Product Owner – Commercial Lines will be responsible for defining and delivering Commercial Insurance capabilities across Property, Marine, Engineering, Liability, Miscellaneous, and Specialty Lines. The role will own the roadmap, product capabilities, underwriting workflows, ecosystem integrations, and technology delivery for the Commercial Lines portfolio

Key Accountabilities

• Own Commercial Lines product roadmap and delivery priorities

• Drive successful implementation of underwriting, policy administration, servicing, claims, and reinsurance capabilities

• Improve underwriting efficiency and customer experience

• Enable rapid launch of new products and broker partnerships

• Drive automation and AI-assisted underwriting initiatives


Product Ownership

• Define and manage Commercial Lines roadmap

• Prioritize business requirements, enhancements, and regulatory changes

• Own backlog management and release planning

• Define future-state commercial insurance capabilities


Business & Domain Ownership

• Partner with Underwriting, Claims, Reinsurance, Operations, and Distribution teams

• Support Property, Marine, Engineering, Liability, Miscellaneous Products, Specialty Products

• Drive optimization of underwriting and servicing workflows

• Ensure compliance with underwriting standards and regulatory requirements

Technology & Delivery Leadership

• Own delivery across PAS, Digital Channels, APIs, and ecosystem integrations

• Collaborate with Architects, Business Analysts, Technical Leads, and SI partners

• Ensure scalability, reliability, and operational readiness

• Participate in sprint planning, release governance, and production readiness reviews

Ecosystem & Partner Management

• Collaborate with:

– Brokers

– Corporate Agents

– Surveyors

– Risk Inspection Partners

– Reinsurers

– Technology Vendors

• Support onboarding of new distribution and service partners

Data, Analytics & AI Enablement

• Define underwriting and portfolio KPIs

• Drive analytics-led underwriting improvements

• Support AI-assisted risk assessment and pricing initiatives


Governance & Controls

• Manage risks, dependencies, and escalations

• Ensure compliance, audit readiness, and operational controls

• Participating in governance forums and steering committees


Required Experience

• 10–15 years of General Insurance experience

• Strong Commercial Lines expertise

• Experience in Property, Marine, Engineering, Liability, or Specialty Lines

• Experience in PAS implementation or transformation programs

• Exposure to Agile delivery methodologies

Educational Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Commerce, or related discipline

• MBA preferred

• Insurance certifications preferred

• Agile /Product certifications preferred


Success Measures

• Product launch timelines

• Underwriting efficiency improvements

• Roadmap delivery adherence

• UAT and production quality

• Automation and STP adoption

• Stakeholder satisfaction

• Successful onboarding of brokers and ecosystem partners

Job Description

Technology…or technology that breathes life into work? SHL, People Science. People Answers.

Are you a seasoned Product Owner with a flair for innovation? Are you ready to shape the future of talent assessment and empower organizations to unlock their full potential? If so, we want you to be a part of the SHL Team! As a Product Owner, you will be part of a Scrum squad, responsible for prioritizing the product backlog to maximize value for a defined area of our HR SaaS product. You will work closely with the development team to refine user stories, align with customer and stakeholder needs, and represent the voice of the customer. This role is ideal for candidates with a background in business analysis or related fields..

An excellent benefit package is offered in a culture where career development, with ongoing manager guidance, collaboration, flexibility, diversity, and inclusivity are all intrinsic to our culture.  There is a huge investment in SHL currently so there’s no better time to become a part of something transformational.

What You Will Be Doing

Backlog Ownership: Own and maintain the product backlog for the assigned Scrum squad, ensuring it is well‑groomed and aligned with user and stakeholder needs.

  • Story Definition: Create clear user stories with well‑defined acceptance criteria and provide ongoing clarification to the development team.
  • Prioritization: Prioritize backlog items based on business value, customer feedback, and strategic direction from the Product Head and Senior Product Owner.
  • Scrum Collaboration: Actively participate in all Scrum ceremonies and support the team during sprint planning and execution.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Gather feedback from stakeholders and users, incorporating insights into the backlog and maintaining transparency on progress and goals.
  • Strategic Alignment: Collaborate with the Senior Product Owner and Product Head to support the product strategy, roadmap, and overall direction.
  • Customer & Process Focus: Build deep customer understanding, assist with product documentation, and contribute to continuous improvement of team processes.

Essential

What we are looking for from you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (e.g. Business, IT) or equivalent experience.
  • Proficiency with collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Miro)
  • Experience with wireframing tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch).
  • 1-3 years of experience in a Business Analyst, or other relevant business role with exposure to software development.
  • Experience with AI-powered software is a plus.
  • Experience working with Data for analytic purposes is a plus

Desirable

  • Communication & Teamwork: Clear communication and effective collaboration in cross‑functional teams.
  • Execution Skills: Strong organization, time management, and problem‑solving abilities.

Get In Touch

Find out how this one-off opportunity can help you to achieve your career goals by making an application to our knowledgeable and friendly Talent Acquisition team. Choose a new path with SHL.

#CareersAtSHL #SHLHiringTalent #ProductOwner #Product #Technology #Innovation

About Us

  • We unlock the possibilities of businesses through the power of people, science and technology.
  • We started this industry of people insight more than 40 years ago and continue to lead the market with powerhouse product launches, ground-breaking science and business transformation.
  • When you inspire and transform people’s lives, you will experience the greatest business outcomes possible. SHL’s products insights, experiences, and services can help achieve growth at scale.

What SHL Can Offer You

Diversity, equity, inclusion and accessibility are key threads in the fabric of SHL’s business and culture (find out more about DEI and accessibility at SHL )

  • Employee benefits package that takes care of you and your family.
  • Support, coaching, and on-the-job development to achieve career success
  • A fun and flexible workplace where you’ll be inspired to do your best work (find out more LifeAtSHL )
  • The ability to transform workplaces around the world for others.

SHL is an equal opportunity employer. We support and encourage applications from a diverse range of candidates. We can, and do make adjustments to make sure our recruitment process is as inclusive as possible.

descriptionHtml:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Position Summary: We are looking for a Product Management Manager to join the Payer Solutions team within the Interoperability Zone at athenahealth in Chennai. This role focuses on building products that enable seamless data exchange and collaboration between payer and provider organizations. You will drive and execute the product roadmap supporting athenahealth's Value-Based Care (VBC) strategy, while helping reduce administrative burden and improve healthcare efficiency. The role offers an opportunity to work on payer onboarding, interoperability, electronic prior authorization (ePA), and standards-based healthcare data exchange initiatives. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, outcome-driven solutions in a fast-paced environment.

About the Team: The Interoperability Zone drives growth and creates meaningful insights from diverse healthcare data sources by enabling scaled global integrations. The team plays a critical strategic role in advancing a connected healthcare ecosystem through interoperability solutions. The Payer Solutions team focuses on payer-provider collaboration, interoperability workflows, and operational tooling that support healthcare efficiency and value-based care initiatives. The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and external stakeholders to deliver innovative healthcare technology solutions.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Drive product strategy, roadmap execution, and delivery for payer interoperability and Value-Based Care initiatives.
  • Define features, epics, user stories, and business requirements with a strong focus on customer outcomes and user experience.
  • Prioritize product backlogs and make trade-off decisions between scope, schedule, and business value.
  • Collaborate with scrum teams to deliver scalable interoperability solutions and platform capabilities.
  • Become a subject matter expert in healthcare interoperability, payer-provider workflows, and regulatory requirements.
  • Foster an API-first mindset and execution approach across product and engineering teams.
  • Partner with stakeholders across business, technology, and customer-facing teams to align product priorities.
  • Use data, metrics, and customer insights to drive product decisions and continuous improvement.

Additional Job Responsibilities

  • Support payer onboarding and integration readiness initiatives.
  • Drive electronic prior authorization (ePA) workflow enhancements and adoption.
  • Ensure compliance with healthcare interoperability regulations, including CMS mandates and the 21st Century Cures Act.
  • Monitor industry trends related to HL7 FHIR, healthcare interoperability, and payer-provider data exchange.
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams on complex technical and integration challenges.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, self-service capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Recommend ongoing product enhancements to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
  • Contribute to tooling and processes that support operational scale, visibility, and exception management.

Expected Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Healthcare Informatics, Business, or a related field.
  • Minimum 8+ years of Product Management, Product Ownership, or relevant Engineering experience.
  • Strong experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in complex business environments.
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7, FHIR, CCD, and healthcare integrations.
  • Prior experience working with healthcare payers, payer interoperability, electronic prior authorization (ePA), Risk Adjustment, or Quality Reporting is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Agile product management practices, backlog prioritization, roadmap planning, and product delivery.
  • Ability to engage deeply in technical discussions with architects and engineering teams, leveraging data and metrics for decision-making; exposure to AI-driven development and automation capabilities is a plus.

About Athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture: Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What We Can Do For You

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative  workspaces  — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About Snowflake

Founded by industry experts and backed by strategic investors, our disruptive built-for-the-cloud architecture was designed to push the limitations of conventional data warehousing. Our teams breed ambition, challenge ordinary thinking, push the pace of innovation, and work hard to provide our customers with the best experience possible.

As an Enterprise Product Manager, your key role will be to optimize and strategically evolve Workday Finance Order to Cash (OTC) IT Systems at Snowflake. You will bridge diverse business stakeholders and skilled development teams, translating complex business requirements into precise, actionable functional specifications for technical implementations.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the entire solution lifecycle for critical OTC systems, from design to deployment. Your expertise will directly impact the efficiency, scalability, and accuracy of Snowflake's revenue-generating processes, ensuring a robust OTC ecosystem.

What You Will Be Doing

As a Staff Enterprise Product Manager, you will independently contribute to and lead the following areas:

  • Process Optimization: Optimize and strategically evolve Workday Finance Order to Cash (OTC) systems, bridging business needs with technical solutions.
  • Operational Excellence: Independently contribute to Customer Contracts, Billing, Collections, Invoices, and Settlements, as well as OTC period close activities.
  • Transformation Projects: Lead and participate in Order Management and Billing transformation projects and large-scale operational changes.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other business application owners to ensure smooth business automation and data management processes across the ecosystem.
  • Roadmap & Strategy: Provide expert input into the IT Roadmap, including Workday new feature rollouts, major releases, and the implementation of new modules.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and champion in driving industry best practices for the evolution of Snowflake’s OTC business users.
  • Agile Leadership: Organize various scrum ceremonies (daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives) using agile methodology.
  • Quality & Training: Lead quality assurance by defining testing strategies, identifying risks, and assisting in the creation of training materials and release notes for OTC users.


Key Duties include:

  • Gathering and translating complex business requirements from diverse stakeholders into actionable functional specifications.
  • Working with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive design and solution documents.
  • Managing communications and change processes for all new changes on the platform.
  • Developing and executing test scripts for UAT, post-sprint, and regression testing.
  • Ensuring system issues are identified, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner.


What We Need To See

  • Education: A Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably with an emphasis in Information Systems or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: Minimum 8+ years of direct experience working on Order to Cash (OTC) implementations or operations as a Business Systems Analyst or Product Manager.
  • Technical Expertise: Expert knowledge of Workday systems or similar ERPs (Oracle Apps, Peoplesoft, SAP) specifically in OTC modules like Quoting, Revenue, Billing, and Collections.
    • Experience integrating custom or 3rd-party applications with Workday or other ERPs.
    • Basic understanding and working knowledge of Databases, including writing SQL queries.
  • Functional Knowledge: Superior understanding of OTC concepts and principles, including Quoting processes, Billings, Cash Applications, and New Product Introductions (NPI).
  • Skills: Highly developed written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
    • Strong attention to detail, goal-oriented mindset, and the ability to adapt to changing requirements.
    • Expert leadership and collaboration skills with the ability to build relationships with stakeholders ranging from executive to line level.
    • Commitment to excellent customer service and a strong focus on quality.
  • Ability: Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
