About Persistent

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026.

About Position

We are hiring a Product Owner with strong Lending (LOS) domain expertise to drive product vision, prioritize features, and lead Agile delivery. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful solutions, ensuring seamless product execution and enhanced customer experience in a fast-paced fintech environment. Please mention a brief description of the position.

  • Role: Product Owner
  • Location: Any PSL Location
  • Experience: 6 to 10 Years
  • Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do

  • Assess business value, develop business cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes aligned with product vision and strategic goals.
  • Define and manage product deliveries, release plans, and feature scope in collaboration with platform leadership.
  • Draft product objectives and strategies, leveraging data-driven insights for decision-making.
  • Define and track KPIs; utilize analytics, A/B testing, and user feedback to refine product features.
  • Convert functional specifications into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog; lead backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions.
  • Manage release planning and track progress through development and QA phases in collaboration with the Scrum Master.
  • Lead software gate reviews, including formal and informal handoffs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on product visioning and concept development.
  • Translate complex sprint outcomes and technical updates into business-friendly summaries.
  • Act as the voice of the customer across engineering, UX, QA, and business teams.
  • Proactively identify and escalate risks and impediments to program leadership.
  • Ensure understanding of end-to-end customer experience, integrations, and technical dependencies.
  • Drive continuous improvement in product development practices.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented culture with shared accountability.

Expertise You'll Bring

  • Experience working as a Product Owner or in a similar role within software product development.
  • Strong domain knowledge in Lending (LOS mandatory) and familiarity with LMS systems.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban); SAFe experience is a plus.
  • Proven ability to write clear user stories and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering, QA, UX, and cross-functional teams.
  • Product Owner certification preferred; Scrum Master certification is an added advantage.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced English communication skills (B2+ or higher).
  • Prior experience in FinTech is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
  • Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
  • Annual health check-ups
  • Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  • We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
  • Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
  • If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers

“Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.”

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Product Owner (Technology Driven Role) based in India.

In this role, you will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, driving the discovery, definition, and delivery of high-impact digital and technology-enabled products. You will shape product direction by translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across technical and non-technical teams. This position requires strong ownership of end-to-end product lifecycle activities, from ideation and requirements gathering through delivery and validation. You will work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to prioritize features, manage dependencies, and optimize delivery outcomes. The role is highly strategic, combining product thinking, process optimization, and technology understanding to enable scalable digital solutions. You will also play a critical role in improving business processes through automation and modern platform capabilities. This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-level product transformation initiatives in a fast-paced, global delivery environment.

Accountabilities

  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and software delivery teams, ensuring alignment on product goals and priorities.
  • Lead requirements gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder interviews to capture and translate business needs into user stories, functional specifications, and process flows.
  • Manage, refine, and prioritize product requirements in collaboration with product management and cross-functional teams.
  • Analyze complex business processes and identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and reengineering.
  • Define and document system dependencies, integration flows, and data mapping requirements across platforms.
  • Collaborate with project managers to plan scope, timelines, resources, and delivery milestones while managing risks and issues.
  • Support Agile delivery by grooming backlogs, facilitating sprint planning, and ensuring clear communication across teams.
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensure delivered solutions meet business expectations and quality standards.
  • Work closely with QA teams to validate functionality and ensure alignment with specifications.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in product ownership and business analysis.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar IT product delivery role.
  • Strong experience working with web and mobile platforms, including API-driven architectures.
  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Proven ability to lead requirement gathering sessions and translate business needs into technical and functional documentation.
  • Experience creating wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to support solution design.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to evaluate and improve complex business processes.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management and ability to work across multiple teams and priorities in high-pressure environments.
  • Highly self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working in cross-functional, team-oriented environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Benefits

  • Opportunity to work on large-scale digital and AI-driven transformation initiatives.
  • Exposure to global clients across multiple industries and domains.
  • Agile, collaborative, and innovation-driven work environment.
  • Strong focus on professional growth, ownership, and leadership development.
  • Flexible and dynamic work culture with cross-functional learning opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation aligned with experience and seniority.
  • Access to modern tools, platforms, and enterprise-grade technology ecosystems.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. About Responsive

Responsive (formerly RFPIO) is the global leader in strategic response management software, transforming how organizations share and exchange critical information. The AI-powered Responsive Platform is purpose-built to manage responses at scale, empowering companies across the world to accelerate growth, mitigate risk and improve employee experiences. Nearly 2,000 customers have standardized on Responsive to respond to RFPs, RFIs, DDQs, ESGs, security questionnaires, ad hoc information requests and more. Learn more at responsive.io.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for Content Management - the knowledge foundation powering AI-assisted responses across the Responsive platform. Content Management is evolving from a traditional repository and governance system into an intelligent knowledge platform powered by AI. The goal is to help customers ingest, curate, improve, govern, and maintain high-quality knowledge with significantly lower manual effort.

  • Intelligent Knowledge Management - This role will focus on building intelligent content management capabilities using AI agents, automation, and workflow intelligence to continuously improve content quality, freshness, trust, and reusability across enterprise response workflows.
  • AI-powered governance and automation - Areas of focus include AI-assisted ingestion and organization, stale content detection, knowledge recommendations, trust and governance workflows, and reducing operational effort involved in content management.
  • Customer and workflow orientation - The role requires strong understanding of enterprise workflows and close engagement with customers and field teams to understand how knowledge quality impacts AI-assisted response workflows and business outcomes.
  • Systems thinking and product depth - We are looking for someone who can think deeply about content systems, knowledge workflows, metadata, trust, permissions, reuse, and AI-assisted orchestration - not just standalone features.

What You’ll Own

  • Define and evolve the roadmap for Content Management capabilities across the Responsive platform
  • Drive product direction for: AI-assisted content ingestion and organization Content quality, freshness, and lifecycle management Trusted retrieval and AI-grounded responses AI-powered governance and automation workflows
  • Improve how organizational knowledge is reused across various use cases - including responses (RFx, questionnaires), field/team queries, and trust center experiences.
  • Define, measure and improve success metrics around content quality, trust, reuse, and operational efficiency
  • Partner closely with Engineering, AI/ML teams, UX, GTM, and customer-facing teams
  • Engage with customers and field teams to understand knowledge management and governance challenges

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience in SaaS, platform, or enterprise workflow products
  • Strong systems thinking and structured problem-solving ability
  • Demonstrated ownership of outcomes, not just feature delivery
  • Experience working with Engineering and AI/ML teams on complex product or platform capabilities
  • Strong product judgment, prioritization, and communication skills
  • Demonstrated AI-first thinking and hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day product workflows

Strong Advantages

  • Familiarity or experience with knowledge management, search/retrieval, governance, AI-assisted workflows, or content systems
  • Experience with AI-powered workflows, copilots, orchestration, or evaluation systems
  • Hands-on use of AI tools for research, prototyping, workflow design, or product development
  • Ability to prototype workflows or use AI-assisted coding tools independently
  • Technical fluency with APIs, LLMs, vector databases, or AI infrastructure concepts
  • B.Tech in Computer Science (or equivalent technical background) and MBA is a plus

Why Solinas

✓ Direct access to leadership: you'll work closely with the leadership team and have real influence on product direction

✓ High-growth startup with proven traction: 30+ cities, multiple national awards, Shark Tank India alumni ✓ Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives and comprehensive healthcare

✓ A team of engineers, roboticists, and domain experts who take the mission seriously — and have fun doing it

title: Product Manager – Investigation management - data42
description: SummaryThe vision of data42 is to inspire collaborative, groundbreaking data and AI initiatives to reimagine drug discovery at Novartis and accelerate time to market, ultimately transforming healthcare and improving lives.As the Product Manager for Investigation Management in data42, you will drive the end-to-end product that enables teams to design, execute, and learn from investigations across R&D—bringing together scientific questions, compliant data access, and guided workflows. You will ensure investigators can seamlessly browse relevant datasets, compose investigation scopes, complete forms, and derive transparent, reproducible findings—accelerating evidence generation and portfolio decisions. descriptionHtml:
Summary

The vision of data42 is to inspire collaborative, groundbreaking data and AI initiatives to reimagine drug discovery at Novartis and accelerate time to market, ultimately transforming healthcare and improving lives.

As the Product Manager for Investigation Management in data42, you will drive the end-to-end product that enables teams to design, execute, and learn from investigations across R&D—bringing together scientific questions, compliant data access, and guided workflows. You will ensure investigators can seamlessly browse relevant datasets, compose investigation scopes, complete forms, and derive transparent, reproducible findings—accelerating evidence generation and portfolio decisions. Join our team at data42!

About The Role

Major accountabilities:

  • Define and communicate the Investigation Management product vision and roadmap, balancing automation with user functionality, and release management (e.g., Investigation request form, UX improvements, LLM-assisted suggestions).
  • Engage end users (researchers, GPHs, data scientists, data engineers, data explorers) to gather requirements, validate personas, and prioritize features via the product council based on scientific impact and operational feasibility.
  • Lead cross-functional delivery across engineering and UX to:
    • Implement LLM-enabled capabilities for form completion, analogy-based scope suggestions, and similar-investigation recommendations.
    • Improve transparency and usability (opt-out for findings/conclusions, clearer data promises during form filling).
    • Assess and evolve application components based on end-user-derived requirements.
  • Own the product lifecycle from ideation to launch and continuous improvement:
    • Scope Investigation Management release thoroughly; implement non-disruptive near-term changes where no fundamental technical issues exist.
    • Evaluate data source alternatives and risks; ensure data inventory and subset per release.
  • Establish and track product metrics:
    • Adoption of investigation cycle-time, data readiness coverage, user satisfaction, and quality/traceability of findings.
    • Measure contribution of LLM features to efficiency and accuracy within compliance constraints.
  • Translate scientific workflows and trial risk management needs into intuitive, governed experiences:
    • From scientific question to scoped investigation, to anonymized data browsing, to reproducible findings.
    • Support co-discovery by surfacing similar scopes and guiding users through transparent, documented decisions.
  • Ensure governed, compliant access to data:
    • Align with privacy, security, and governance standards for anonymization and RWE integration.
  • Consolidate and improve documentation hygiene (creating a single source of truth from fragmented Confluence content) to reduce ambiguity for end users.
Minimum Requirements

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of science, data, and technology, and is passionate about operationalizing investigation workflows at scale. You should excel at translating scientific questions and risk management needs into intuitive, governed digital experiences that balance automation with expert user control.

  • Product Management Expertise:
    • Proven ability to define product vision, strategy, and roadmap for workflow-heavy products.
    • Experience coordinating delivery of modular, integrated releases and managing product councils (or equivalent governance).
  • Data and Technical Acumen:
    • Experience/Familiarity in working with data platforms, data pools, anonymization, RWD integration, and multi-layer architectures.
    • Extensive working knowledge with GenAI/LLM-assisted features (form completion, scope suggestions, similarity search) and their constraints in regulated settings.
    • Understanding of data models, metadata standards and alignment, and trade-offs in switching or harmonizing sources.
  • Leadership and Collaboration:
    • Skilled in influencing diverse stakeholders (GPHs, data scientists, data engineers, “data explorers”) and aligning on requirements from end-user interviews.
    • Ability to manage feedback fatigue and drive clarity on personas and value propositions.
  • Scientific and Data Literacy:
    • Understanding of R&D investigation workflows, trial risk management needs, and multi-modal data readiness.
    • Ability to translate scientific questions into data requirements and governed access patterns.
Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of product management experience in data-driven or workflow-centric products; exposure to pharma R&D or scientific data platforms preferred.
  • Track record delivering complex, cross-functional products with strong execution and change management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills focused on data readiness, usability, and compliance.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities; experience consolidating fragmented documentation.
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies and modern product management tools.

Languages

  • English.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner (Client Experience) based in India.

This role focuses on shaping and improving the post-payment experience for a global digital product used by millions of customers worldwide. You will be responsible for ensuring that paying users quickly reach meaningful value by successfully connecting and engaging with relevant matches. The position sits at the intersection of product strategy, user behavior, and data-driven optimization, with a strong emphasis on activation and customer success. You will work in a fast-paced, international environment alongside cross-functional teams including analytics, design, and engineering. The goal is to reduce friction in discovery and matching flows while increasing user satisfaction and engagement. This is a high-impact role where your decisions directly influence user retention and perceived product value across multiple global markets.

Accountabilities

  • Own and continuously improve the post-payment customer journey across core product experiences, ensuring users reach meaningful engagement quickly and consistently.
  • Increase user activation by helping paying customers find high-quality matches and sustain early communication within the first week of use.
  • Identify friction points in discovery, recommendation, and matching flows, and design solutions to improve relevance and user satisfaction.
  • Optimize the quality and personalization of offers, invites, and recommendations based on user behavior and preferences.
  • Define and refine customer segmentation strategies to tailor experiences to different user needs and expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with analytics, engineering, and design teams to test hypotheses, measure impact, and iterate on solutions.
  • Develop engagement and reactivation mechanics, including personalization, gamification, and communication tools to improve retention and value realization.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in B2C product management, ideally in platforms with complex discovery, matching, or recommendation systems.
  • Proven track record of improving user activation, onboarding, or time-to-value in consumer-facing digital products.
  • Solid understanding of customer journey design, particularly in post-payment or subscription-based environments.
  • Experience working with data-driven product development, including experimentation, A/B testing, and behavioral analysis.
  • Ability to design and improve segmentation, personalization, and recommendation logic.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify core user problems beyond surface-level feature requests.
  • Experience working with high-choice environments where users navigate multiple offers, options, or pathways.
  • Fluent Russian is required.

Benefits

  • Fully remote work opportunity.
  • 28 calendar days of annual vacation.
  • 7 wellness days per year for rest and personal needs without using sick leave.
  • Annual training and development support (50% coverage) for courses, conferences, and professional events.
  • English language learning discounts for employees.
  • Health support allowance of up to $1,000 gross per year for medical insurance or healthcare expenses for employees and close family members.
  • Workplace support budget of up to $1,000 gross every 3 years for home office setup or co-working space expenses.
  • Internal gamified recognition system with rewards redeemable for merchandise, experiences, and team activities.
  • Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. The successful candidate will be a strong communicator, great at meeting multiple deadlines through exceptional planning skills, capable to coordinate with multiple stakeholders, and comfortable with a varied set of software and editing tools.

Experience in product marketing is highly desired. Our environment is fast-paced and requires someone who is flexible, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with multiple teams, vendors, partners, and management and has deep experience in setting up and measuring and managing Onsite and Outbound campaigns, content testing and experimentation.

A day in the life

You'll be responsible for defining roadmaps to facilitate and accelerate our team's marketing operations, expanding our reach to all available Prime countries. You will be heavily involved in both launching member growth products worldwide that impact the customer journey defining and executing the marketing strategy and participating in the development of tooling solutions to support Prime marketers. You will work in close collaboration with product leaders, as well as tech teams to identify new opportunities to invent and simplify.

About The Team

You'll be joining a diverse, cross-cultural highly engaged and collaborative globally focused team that is passionate about innovating and improving the experience and content for Prime members worldwide

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
  • Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
  • Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
  • Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
  • Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
  • Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

HP is seeking a Senior PLM COE Product Owner to join the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Center of Excellence within Supply Chain Transformation. This role owns and evolves enterprise PLM capabilities that directly enable supply chain performance, scalability, compliance, and risk reduction across HP’s global product portfolio.

The role independently drives complex, cross‑functional initiatives within SAP S/4HANA (MS4), partnering across business, IT, and enterprise architecture to deliver business‑relevant, scalable solutions that support long‑term supply chain strategy and operational execution.

This is a senior individual contributor position for a leader who operates with a high level of autonomy, leads through influence, and provides clear recommendations, trade‑offs, and decisions across the full lifecycle—from strategic intake and prioritization through release, adoption, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own one or more enterprise PLM capabilities end to end, from strategic intake and prioritization through delivery, release, adoption, and continuous optimization, ensuring solutions support supply chain effectiveness, product readiness, and business continuity
  • Serve as the business owner and solution authority for assigned PLM domains, with accountability for direction, decisions, outcomes, and measurable business value
  • Translate supply chain, engineering, and business priorities into actionable solution direction, aligning enterprise architecture, governance requirements, and PLM COE strategy
  • Lead requirement shaping, user story clarification, and acceptance criteria definition, ensuring scope clarity, data integrity, and optimized supply chain outcomes, with business benefits clearly documented
  • Develop and drive key design decisions and trade‑off recommendations, securing approvals through governance forums including Product Data Governance and the Architecture Review Board (ARB)
  • Ensure funding readiness, prioritization alignment, and organizational preparedness prior to release commitment
  • Own delivery outcomes in partnership with PLM IT through a 2‑in‑a‑Box model, proactively identifying risks, managing dependencies, and driving resolution with a clear, fact‑based point of view
  • Define and execute UAT strategy and sign‑off, ensuring SOX compliance, audit readiness, and controlled risk mitigation for production releases
  • Lead release readiness, cutover planning, hypercare, and post‑release continuous improvement, ensuring adoption and sustained supply chain and operational impact
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, clearly communicating scope, progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations, and representing the domain with credibility across regions and functions
  • Drive cross‑functional decisions to closure in ambiguous or rapidly changing environments, maintaining momentum while balancing business risk, value, and technical constraints

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent experience
  • Extensive experience in PLM, ERP, and supply‑chain‑integrated systems, preferably in complex, global enterprise environments
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA preferred, or comparable enterprise platforms
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, strategic initiatives in matrixed organizations
  • Familiarity with Agile or user‑story‑based delivery models

Knowledge and Skills

  • Deep knowledge of PLM concepts, including BOM structures, product master data, and lifecycle governance
  • Strong understanding of how product data, PLM governance, and system decisions impact supply chain performance and business risk
  • Experience operating in compliance‑driven and audit‑controlled environments
  • Familiarity with system integrations, data flows, and cross‑platform dependencies
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills
  • Ability to synthesize complex data and ambiguity into clear recommendations and executive‑ready guidance

Leadership Skills and Behaviors

  • Leads through influence across business, IT, and supply chain stakeholders
  • Operates independently on complex problems requiring in‑depth evaluation of multiple factors
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and follow‑through for strategic decisions and outcomes
  • Comfortable engaging with senior leaders, defending recommendations, and advising on trade‑offs, risks, and growth opportunities
  • Exhibits learning agility, digital fluency, and a continuous improvement mindset aligned with HP values

Impact & Scope

  • Impacts enterprise supply chain and product lifecycle capabilities, providing expertise and leadership across functional and cross‑functional initiatives
  • Contributes to the development of competitive, scalable supply chain solutions through standardized PLM capabilities

Disclaimer

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

In our ‘always on’ world, we believe it’s essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.
About The Role
RUCKUS Networks is looking for a Sr. Manager, Product Marketing Associate to join our growing Product Marketing team. This is an exciting role ideal for a mid-career professional who is passionate about B2B technology, enterprise networking, and translating complex technical concepts into compelling go-to-market strategies and can creatively leverage the new AI tools to work efficiently.
You will work alongside experienced product marketers and cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Sales, and Engineering, to help bring RUCKUS Wi-Fi, switching, and AI-driven network management solutions to market.
What You'll Do
Go-to-Market & Product Launches
  • Support end-to-end product launch activities including messaging documents, launch briefs, and internal readiness kits for new RUCKUS Wi-Fi access points, switching, and cloud networking solutions.
  • Assist in crafting positioning and value proposition frameworks tailored to key verticals such as hospitality, education, healthcare, and enterprise.
Content & Collateral Development
  • Write and maintain product marketing assets including data sheets, solution briefs, web copy, battle cards, and blog posts.
  • Develop customer-facing presentations and pitch decks for the sales team.
  • Contribute to video scripts, demo narratives, and event booth messaging.
Sales Enablement
  • Create and update sales enablement materials that help the field team articulate RUCKUS product differentiation
  • Support the creation of onboarding materials for new sales reps and channel partners.
Market & Customer Research
  • Conduct ongoing market analysis and research to identify trends, buyer personas, and emerging use cases in enterprise networking.
  • Assist with customer and partner interviews, win/loss analysis, and feedback synthesis.
Campaign & Event Support
  • Coordinate with the Growth Marketing team to supply messaging, assets, and product expertise for digital campaigns and email nurture programs.
  • Support participation at industry events.
  • Track and report on campaign performance metrics tied to product marketing activities.
Required Qualifications
What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in marketing, product marketing or product management.
  • Proficiency with Gen AI tools and an above-average comfort level with prompt engineering
  • Strong communication skills — you can explain complex technical ideas clearly and concisely.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office; familiarity with presentation design tools (PowerPoint, Canva, etc.)
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Naturally curious about technology, especially networking, cloud, or enterprise IT.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Exposure to global B2B marketing environment
  • Familiarity with enterprise networking concepts and market
  • Prior experience in a tech company, SaaS, or B2B environment.
Location
Bengaluru, India or Chennai, India.
Why Join Us?
Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.
RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.
If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.
Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

Leads the planning and rollout of assigned products through ownership of product concepts, roadmaps, and prioritization with delivery teams. Navigates a dynamic and distributed stakeholder and development environment to build and maintain a prioritized roadmap. Owns product backlog and release plan. Champions and supports the product development team by reducing churn and waste, removing blockers, escalating issues and offering ideas, solutions, and technical product guidance.

What Part Will You Play?

  • For moderately complex product offerings, leverages expertise in financial services markets and/or Agile software product development to drive product innovation, roadmap priorities, and requirements for the assigned product offering that serves to further distinguish our capabilities from the competition and to deepen engagement for our clients’ customers. Close collaboration with product development team is key to success.
  • Works closely with our leadership, sales, and client teams to pinpoint opportunities for our strategic focus, and ensures the release themes and plans align to deliver the capabilities to enable winning in the marketplace. Determines methods and procedures for alignment to product strategy.
  • Facilitates product innovation and roadmap planning sessions. Actively offers ideas, solutions, and technical product guidance on solution feasibility, approach, and high level scope.
  • Participates in release and sprint planning sessions to select appropriate priorities from the product backlog for inclusion in the release priorities. Able to discern appropriate priorities from the backlog based on a variety of factors, including input from multiple teams (Market Strategy, Portfolio Management, and Client Implementations, among others), scope/sizing considerations, functional synergies, etc.
  • Adopts the structured approach to facilitate product scenario, epic, and solution requirements sessions for product enhancements. Actively participates in design review and product demo sessions, offering critical and insightful feedback.
  • Drives effective release priority communications plan to ensure that all appropriate internal teams have visibility to the contents of critical commitments in the releases, as well as visibility into overall product readiness. This includes ensuring that key product decisions made within the delivery cycle are communicated and understood so that product readiness and intent are achieved. May include driving and coordinating many aspects of go-to-market planning and execution (e.g. pricing, contracts, value proposition and messaging, etc.).
  • Works with technical writing team members to deliver product documentation to ensure effective internal and external communications of each release. This includes user guides, implementation guides, release notes, and various internal release communication sessions.
  • Collaborates within and outside of the product management team to ensure product relevance and prioritization across segment offerings.
  • Not an exhaustive list; other duties as assigned.

What Are We Looking For in This Role?

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Relevant Experience or Degree in: Computer Science or equivalent field from an accredited university is required; however, relevant experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.
  • Typically a minimum of 6 years
  • Demonstrated track record in product development/management, preferably cloud based SaaS products in a client-facing environment. Strong technical aptitude. Experience with Agile delivery methodology preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree
  • Computer Science or equivalent field from an accredited university.

What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?

  • Skills / Knowledge - Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve moderately complex issues in creative and effective ways. Having ownership of a sub-function, account or matrix management responsibilities, applies knowledge to meet goals, maintain relationships, propose opportunities to expand the business, and lead matrix teams. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., dept./peer review).
  • Job Complexity - Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise. Builds on/Maintains external relationships of assigned accounts.
  • Supervision - Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel (Team Lead).

Specialist - Product Owner - IN

The role act as liaisons between different stakeholders, including engineering, operations, and business to execute product strategy. They maintain and manage the product backlog, or the prioritized list of requirements for future product development.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

  • Incumbents in this role may also be responsible for modernization and integration efforts.
  • Product Owners work very closely with Product Managers to create user stories.
  • They author documents relating to product life cycle including product roadmap, business requirements and functional specifications.
  • They participate in sprint planning, perform market research and competitive analysis leading to the iterative development of the product.

Educational Requirements

  • University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience

  • 3+ Years Required; 5+ Years Preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Career Level

7IC

  • Liaising with different stake holders and business users to understand the requirement/problem areas and work with development team to resolve it.

  • Collecting data from various sources via different processes, understand those processes.
  • Exploring and visualizing data.
  • Should be able to write SQL queries and fetch the data and review it.
  • Clearly communicating the findings from the analysis to turn information into something actionable through reports, dashboards, and/or presentations.

Key Skills Required:

  • Analyzing and translating business needs to create and propose solutions through presentations and flow diagram
  • Experience with data integration from multiple sources
  • Experience with End of day and Start of day activities on Accounting book of records
  • Must have Proficiency in at least one query language, especially SQL. (Python Preferred)
  • Must have experience in Asset management domain.
  • Understanding of Performance calculation & Analytics domain
  • Must have experience in different asset classes and their performance, attribution.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL DB is good to have.
  • Good communication skills.

Required Experience- 5-10 Years

Education- Engineering/ Masters (Finance)/CIPM/CFA/FRM or equivalent certification

Related Skills

Continuous Integration and Deployment, Debugging, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Problem Solving, Programming, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle, Software Testing, Systems Design/Analysis, Systems Development Life Cycle

descriptionHtml:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Join Siemens Gamesa and step into a hands-on role where you shape how SCADA hardware platforms are built, configured, and delivered at scale. You start your day partnering with engineering, production, and procurement to ensure the right hardware and software, BOMs, and variants are ready for real projects. You lead decisions that balance standardization, flexibility, cost, and compliance, keeping platforms reliable and easy to manufacture. Along the way, you stay close to business units on production processes and suppliers, turning long-term platform standards into practical, repeatable solutions that support the global energy transition.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Own and maintain the generic and configurable Bill of Materials (BOM) for SCADA projects across business units
  • Define and manage product variants and part numbers, ensuring accuracy, usability, and lifecycle clarity
  • Collaborate with engineering, production, and suppliers to ensure hardware platforms meet software, system, and project requirements
  • Ensure platforms are compliance-ready, including CE and UL marking, working closely with internal teams and suppliers
  • Partner with Business units, production facilities, procurement, and service teams to deliver manufacturable, scalable, and well-documented SCADA solutions


What You Bring

  • Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar role within hardware, platform, or industrial systems
  • Strong understanding of BOM structures, product variants, and product lifecycle management
  • Hands-on experience working with production environments, suppliers, and procurement teams
  • Familiarity with product compliance and certification standards such as CE and UL
  • Clear, confident communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical, operational, and commercial stakeholders


About The Team

You will join the Platform Production Team within Siemens Gamesa, focusing on SCADA hardware platforms and BOM management. The team works across engineering, production, procurement, suppliers, and delivery organizations to ensure SCADA platforms are reliable, compliant, and easy to configure. Together, the team supports the full lifecycle of SCADA panel deliveries, from design and production to installation and upgrades. Collaboration, trust, and practical problem-solving are central to how the team operates. The work directly supports multiple business units and real customer projects worldwide.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

  • Opportunities to work with a global team
  • Medical benefits
  • Remote/Flexible work
  • Paid holidays and parental leave
  • Employer-funded pension
  • Subsidised lunch and more

Job Description

Join Firmwide Financial Controllers to drive strategic data and platform transformation across Finance, Credit Risk, and Treasury. You will shape the Banking Book roadmap, improve data quality, and deliver monthly releases through strong product ownership and governance. This role offers broad stakeholder exposure and the opportunity to build scalable, cloud-enabled data foundations.

As a Banking Book Product Owner Analyst within Firmwide Financial Controllers (FFC) on the Business Architecture team, you will partner with lines of business, SMEs, and technology teams to translate product and data needs into scalable Finance and Risk solutions. You will prioritize the Banking Book roadmap, manage monthly release delivery, and apply disciplined program and change governance across data acquisition, testing, and adoption. You will drive data quality, lineage, and process improvements to strengthen decision-useful reporting and operational efficiency.

Job Responsibilities

  • Prioritize Banking Book product backlog and define a roadmap aligned to Finance and Risk data acquisition objectives.
  • Write business requirements as user stories with clear acceptance criteria to enhance data, testing, reporting automation, and analytics toolsets.
  • Partner with developers to translate business needs into technical specifications and validate delivered outcomes.
  • Manage release plans covering scope, milestones, resourcing, test strategy, execution readiness, and stakeholder activities.
  • Collaborate with lines of business to understand products, data capture, and strategic sourcing into cloud-based big data architecture.
  • Drive adherence to product, SDLC, and release management standards and operating models.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and produce supporting documentation to enhance end-user experience.
  • Coordinate with implementation leads, release managers, project managers, and data SMEs to align data/system flows with Finance and Risk applications.
  • Oversee SDLC execution from requirements through testing and deployment to ensure seamless integration and delivery.
  • Analyze datasets to identify trends and support decisions while strengthening data governance, quality, and management practices.
  • Support DQ analysis and remediation activities by tracking issues, actions, and outcomes through to closure.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Hold a Bachelorâs degree with 3+ years of experience in product ownership or project management focused on process re-engineering.
  • Demonstrate Product Owner experience and strong working knowledge of agile principles and delivery of complex programs.
  • Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to rapidly assimilate business and technical knowledge.
  • Use Jira and Microsoft Office effectively to manage workflow, documentation, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences through strong written and verbal communication.
  • Manage multiple workstreams concurrently with strong organization, sound judgment, and a risk mindset.
  • Operate effectively under pressure with high attention to detail and ownership of deadlines and deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Leverage SQL and data tooling experience, including Databricks and visualization/analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Alteryx, Python).
  • Apply knowledge of traditional credit products (e.g., loans, deposits, cash) and/or trading products (e.g., derivatives, securities).
  • Demonstrate experience as a product lead in Finance, Risk, or Operations within financial services.
  • Apply familiarity with liquidity and credit reporting data and related sourcing/controls.
  • Demonstrate understanding of financial and regulatory reporting processes.
  • Utilize basic knowledge of cloud technologies (e.g., AWS).
  • Promote strong data governance and lineage practices to support auditability and sustainable controls.

ABOUT US

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the worldâs most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicantsâ and employeesâ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that weâre setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

Kenvue Is Currently Recruiting For a

Lead Product Owner

What We Do

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.

Who We Are

Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.

Role Reports To

Product Manager

Location:

Asia Pacific, India, Karnataka, Bangalore

Work Location:

Hybrid

What You Will Do

Kenvue is currently recruiting for:

Lead Product Owner, Data Products

This position reports into Principal Solutions Architect, Global Data Products and is based in GCC, Bengaluru.

What You Will Do

As a Lead Product Owner, you will be responsible for leading the development and deployment of data-driven products powered by digital, artificial intelligence and analytics technologies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to define product vision, strategy, and execution.

Responsibilities

  • Product Vision and Strategy: Collaborate with stakeholders to define the product vision, goals, and roadmap for Digital, Data and AI products that align with business objectives.
  • Requirements Gathering: Work closely with business units to understand their needs and translate them into clear and actionable product requirements.
  • Data Management: Oversee data collection, storage, and preprocessing to ensure data quality and availability for training and model deployment.
  • Machine Learning Models: Coordinate with data scientists and ML engineers to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models that power AI data products.
  • Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product development process, including design, development, testing, and deployment of AI data products.
  • Performance Monitoring: Establish metrics and tracking mechanisms to measure the performance and impact of AI data products.
  • Product Iteration and Improvement: Continuously iterate and improve data products based on user feedback and performance insights.
  • Market Analysis: Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and stay abreast of industry trends.

Required Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experiences with a Bachelor's degree; or 5 years and a Master degree in Business or Information management systems (MIS); or a PhD with 5 years of experiences in the field of Technology, Computer/Software Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics etc.
  • 3+ years of experience working in CPG/Retail industry and sound knowledge in business/data domains related to Customer, Product, Consumer, Finance etc.
  • Proven experience in product management, preferably with a focus on data-driven products and AI technologies.
  • Understand business requirements and translate to Conceptual (CDM), Logical (LDM) and Physical (PDM) data model by using industry standards.
  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts, algorithms, and model deployment.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to lead cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, visualization, and data-driven decision-making and proficiency in writing SQL Queries.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Understanding of data privacy and security considerations in AI product development.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies is a plus.
  • Experience working in Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Catalog and Business Glossary.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

Job Description

Senior Specialist, POM Product Owner

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of SENIOR SPECIALIST to join our Corporate Trust – Analytics team. This role is located in Pune, MH.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Position Summary - This position is responsible for analyzing and understanding deal requirements and then building/programming computer models to reflect those requirements.
  • The incumbent will be required to read and understand deal related legal documentation and identify the relevant details and information to enable them to create the deal model in BNY proprietary tools/Excel. In addition, the Analyst will provide support and ongoing maintenance for existing deal models using both bespoke and proprietary systems.
  • This role supports and assists the Client onshore to ensure delivery of good client service by accurate and timely completion of client requests. The quality and timeliness directly affect how the organization is perceived by our clients.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • T-SQL, PL/SQL or similar database query writing experience is must.
  • 6+ Years of experience as SQL/ SSRS / Power BI developer is desired.
  • Knowledge of programming languages like VBA, Java, .Net would be a plus but not mandatory.
  • Candidate should have good Analytical and Problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in Git Lab would be a plus.
  • Understanding of structured finance product CDO (Collateralized Debt Obligation) and other financial instruments (Bonds, Loans, Swaps, etc.) would be a plus.
  • Experience in Finance domain would be a plus.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Position Summary: We are looking for a Manager, Product Management to join the Remittance & Posting sub-zone within the Collector organization at athenahealth in Chennai. This role focuses on driving product initiatives that support payment processing and banking integrations across multiple banking partners within athenahealth’s Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) ecosystem. The Product Manager will collaborate with banking vendors, cross-functional teams, and technical stakeholders to define product requirements, prioritize roadmap initiatives, scope MVPs, and deliver scalable platform capabilities. The ideal candidate will combine strong product management expertise with an understanding of business workflows, banking processes, and platform-driven product development.

About the Team: The Collector organization at athenahealth is a core part of the company’s Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) business, supporting healthcare financial operations and customer revenue outcomes. The Remittance & Posting sub-zone focuses on payment processing workflows, banking integrations, and scalable financial operations that enable efficient healthcare reimbursement processes. The team works closely with product, engineering, banking vendors, and operational stakeholders to build innovative solutions that improve scalability, customer experience, and payment processing efficiency across the athenahealth platform.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Gain expertise in healthcare financial workflows, remittance processing, and banking integration processes
  • Collaborate with banking vendors and cross-functional teams to define and deliver scalable payment processing capabilities
  • Define epics, user stories, MVP scope, and business requirements including UX and customer experience considerations
  • Prioritize product roadmap initiatives based on measurable business value, operational impact, and customer outcomes
  • Act as Product Owner for scrum teams, driving product decisions, trade-offs, and delivery execution
  • Partner with product leadership to influence strategic product direction and platform growth initiatives
  • Support feature launches and adoption activities through collaboration with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and operational teams

Additional Job Responsibilities

  • Coordinate banking integration requirements and ensure successful onboarding of multiple banking partners
  • Drive cross-functional communication and alignment across technical, operational, and customer-facing teams
  • Monitor product performance, customer feedback, and operational metrics to guide future enhancements
  • Contribute to scalable platform strategies that support athenahealth’s growth and payment processing expansion goals
  • Ensure agile product management best practices are followed throughout the product lifecycle
  • Support risk assessment, dependency management, and issue resolution during product delivery phases
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to continuously improve workflow efficiency and customer experience

Expected Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Product Management or related field
  • Minimum 8–12 years of product management experience
  • Prior experience managing two or more products required
  • Strong understanding of product development concepts including microservices architecture, SaaS platforms, and micro front-end technologies
  • Experience working in agile development environments and applying product management best practices
  • Healthcare industry or healthcare interoperability experience (HL7, CCDs, Interface Engines, integrations) preferred
  • Experience in the U.S. banking industry or banking/payment integration workflows is an added advantage
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills

About Athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture: Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What We Can Do For You

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative  workspaces  — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

descriptionHtml:
Why Join Iris?

Are you ready to do the best work of your career at one of India’s Top 25 Best Workplaces in IT industry? Do you want to grow in an award-winning culture that truly values your talent and ambitions?

Join Iris Software — one of the fastest-growing IT services companies — where you own and shape your success story.

About Us

At Iris Software, our vision is to be our client’s most trusted technology partner, and the first choice for the industry’s top professionals to realize their full potential.

With over 4,300 associates across India, U.S.A, and Canada, we help our enterprise clients thrive with technology-enabled transformation across financial services, healthcare, transportation & logistics, and professional services.

Our work covers complex, mission-critical applications with the latest technologies, such as high-value complex Application & Product Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cloud, DevOps, Data & MLOps, Quality Engineering, and Business Automation.

Working with Us

At Iris, every role is more than a job — it’s a launchpad for growth.

Our Employee Value Proposition, “Build Your Future. Own Your Journey.” reflects our belief that people thrive when they have ownership of their career and the right opportunities to shape it.

We foster a culture where your potential is valued, your voice matters, and your work creates real impact. With cutting-edge projects, personalized career development, continuous learning and mentorship, we support you to grow and become your best — both personally and professionally.

Curious what it’s like to work at Iris? Head to this video for an inside look at the people, the passion, and the possibilities. Watch it here.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Strategy and Vision
  • Define and communicate the long-term vision and strategic roadmap for the core platform, encompassing infrastructure, shared services, common frameworks, developer tools, and security standards.
  • Act as the voice of the internal customer (other Product Teams, Engineering Teams, DevOps) to understand their dependency needs, pain points, and requirements for performance, scalability, and resilience.
  • Analyze market trends in platform technology (e.g., Cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Observability) to ensure the platform remains modern, cost-effective, and competitive.
  • Define Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for the platform, focusing on technical metrics like developer velocity, system reliability, security compliance, and cost efficiency.
  • Platform Development and Prioritization
  • Manage, groom, and prioritize the Platform Backlog, translating architectural epics, technical debt, and cross-cutting requirements into clear user stories with defined acceptance criteria.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, reviews) for the Platform Engineering team.
  • Balance conflicting priorities between immediate feature delivery support, critical security patches, and necessary long-term architectural investment (technical debt repayment).
  • Collaborate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Leads to ensure all platform development aligns with the overall Enterprise Architecture.
  • Accept or reject completed stories based on the Definition of Done, ensuring high standards for code quality, documentation, security, and operational readiness.
  • Stakeholder Management and Communication
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Platform Engineering team and the consuming Product Teams.
  • Manage communication and dependencies across multiple technical teams, clearly articulating platform capabilities, upcoming changes, and migration paths.
  • Create and maintain high-quality documentation (APIs, integration guides, service catalog) to accelerate adoption and reduce cognitive load for dependent teams.
  • Conduct internal demos and training to socialize new platform features and drive adoption across the organization.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience
  • 5+ years of experience in software development, engineering management, or product ownership in a technical domain.
  • 3+ years specifically serving as a Product Owner or Technical Lead for a platform, infrastructure, or shared services team.
  • Proven experience working with complex, distributed systems (Microservices, APIs) and Cloud-Native technologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Technical Fluency
  • Strong understanding of modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and service meshes.
  • Working knowledge of core platform components such as API Gateways, identity management (OAuth/OpenID), monitoring (Observability), and container orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker).
  • Ability to read, understand, and discuss technical designs, architectural diagrams, and trade-offs with Principal Engineers.

Mandatory Competencies

BA - Business Analyst - Requirement Gathering

BA - Business Analyst - GAP Analysis

BA - Business Analyst - SWOT Analysis

BA - SQL

BA - Business Analyst - Business Process Modelling

Beh - Communication and collaboration

Perks And Benefits For Irisians

Iris provides world-class benefits for a personalized employee experience. These benefits are designed to support financial, health and well-being needs of Irisians for a holistic professional and personal growth. Click here to view the benefits.

About The Role

We are seeking a Digital Product Owner to lead AI-driven workflows supporting Portfolio and Clinical research across R&D.

This role owns the design, development, and adoption of AI/ML-enabled workflows that accelerate portfolio decision-making, clinical data analysis, and cross-program insights. The position sits at the intersection of data science, clinical development, and digital platforms — translating complex scientific and operational needs into scalable, production-ready digital solutions.

You will work closely with clinical scientists, portfolio strategy teams, data scientists, and platform engineering to deliver AI-enabled workflows that are reliable, compliant, and measurable in impact. This is a domain-focused AI product ownership role built on top of enterprise workflow and data platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical development teams

  • Product Ownership
  • Own the roadmap and backlog for Portfolio & Clinical AI workflows.
  • Define use cases and requirements for AI/ML-driven analytics, decision-support tools, and automated workflow capabilities.
  • Translate scientific, clinical, and portfolio needs into clear product specifications.
  • Ensure workflows are production-ready, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  • AI Workflow Design & Enablement
  • Partner with data scientists to operationalize machine learning and generative AI models into reproducible workflows.
  • Define integration patterns between AI models, enterprise data systems, and workflow execution environments.
  • Ensure traceability, reproducibility, and auditability of AI-driven outputs in regulated contexts.
  • Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate with:

Portfolio strategy and governance stakeholders

Data science and AI engineering teams

Platform and infrastructure partners

  • Align workflow priorities with portfolio milestones and clinical development timelines.
  • Proactively manage dependencies on underlying data and workflow platforms.
  • Delivery & Execution
  • Lead agile development cycles in partnership with engineering and Scrum teams.
  • Maintain a prioritized backlog that balances short-term impact with long-term workflow scalability.
  • Define success metrics tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and scientific outcomes.
  • Oversee pilot launches, iteration cycles, and scaling of successful workflows.
  • Continuous Improvement & Impact Measurement
  • Track adoption, usability, and scientific impact of deployed AI workflows.
  • Gather feedback from clinical and portfolio users to refine capabilities.
  • Identify new AI opportunities aligned with strategic research priorities.

Key Requirements

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management or Product Ownership, preferably in life sciences, clinical research, or AI/ML environments.
  • Experience delivering AI-driven or analytics-driven products to scientific or clinical users.
  • Strong understanding of clinical development processes and portfolio governance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and enterprise data systems.

Technical Skills

  • Solid understanding of machine learning lifecycle concepts (model development, validation, deployment, monitoring).
  • Experience translating data science outputs into operational workflows.
  • Familiarity with data engineering, APIs, and workflow orchestration environments is a plus.
  • Understanding of compliance and audit requirements in regulated research settings is preferred.

Soft Skills

  • Strong ability to communicate complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinking with a focus on measurable research and business impact.
  • Proven ability to operate across scientific, technical, and operational domains.
  • Comfortable managing ambiguity in emerging AI use cases.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Clinical Research, or related field.
  • Advanced degree (Ph.D., M.D., or equivalent) in a scientific or clinical discipline is a plus.
